B: Go to school tomorrow.

A: Tomorrow is Saturday, off.

B: Yes, I forgot. I want to sleep at home tomorrow morning, and I want to go to the bookstore to buy books in the afternoon. What about you?

A: I want to go shopping.

B: What do you want to buy?

A: I want to buy a cup, a carton of milk, and some fruit.

B: What fruit do you like to eat?

A: I like to eat bananas and apples.

B: There is no more fruit at my house. The apples are very good now. Please help me buy a pound.

A: No problem. What time should I give you the apple tomorrow?

B: I will go home from the bookstore at five o'clock tomorrow. You can come to my house at five o'clock. You can also have dinner at my house and we can cook it ourselves tomorrow, how about that?

A: OK, I will go to your house at five o'clock tomorrow.

14250.title: Shopping
simplified_paragraphs: A：先生，你想买什么？
B：我很渴，有喝的东西吗？
A：有。我们有水、茶、牛奶、咖啡、啤酒，你想喝什么？
B：我要一瓶啤酒。
A：好的，还要什么吗？
B：我也买些吃的东西吧。
A：没问题。我们有米饭、面条，也有面包，你想要哪个？
B：一个面包。一共多少钱？
A：啤酒三块五，面包十块，一共十三块五。
B：好的，给你钱。
A：这是你买的东西，再见。
B：再见。

13535.title: Yǎn’ěr dào líng
simplified_paragraphs: 从前有一个人，看见别人家门口有一个大钟，就想把它偷走。可是钟又大又重，他就拿来一个铁锤，想把钟敲碎，然后一块一块地偷走。但是铁锤敲钟会有很大的声音，所有人都能听见，他肯定会被发现。他又想了想：如果敲钟的时候把自己的耳朵捂起来，就什么都听不到了！他觉得自己听不到声音，别人也一定听不到。然后他一边捂耳朵，一边用铁锤敲钟。很多人都听到了钟声，赶来把这个小偷抓住了。这个成语就是“掩耳盗铃”，我们经常用这个成语来比喻自己骗自己的行为。
traditional_paragraphs: 從前有一個人，看見別人家門口有一個大鐘，就想把它偷走。可是鐘又大又重，他就拿來一個鐵錘，想把鐘敲碎，然後一塊一塊地偷走。但是鐵錘敲鐘會有很大的聲音，所有人都能聽見，他肯定會被發現。他又想了想：如果敲鐘的時候把自己的耳朵捂起來，就什麼都聽不到了！他覺得自己聽不到聲音，別人也一定聽不到。然後他一邊捂耳朵，一邊用鐵錘敲鐘。很多人都聽到了鐘聲，趕來把這個小偷抓住了。這個成語就是“掩耳盜鈴”，我們經常用這個成語來比喻自己騙自己的行為。
pinyin_paragraphs: cóng qián yǒu yī gè rén， kàn jiàn bié rén jiā mén kǒu yǒu yī gè dà zhōng， jiù xiǎng bǎ tā tōu zǒu。 kě shì zhōng yòu dà yòu zhòng， tā jiù ná lái yī gè tiě chuí， xiǎng bǎ zhōng qiāo suì， rán hòu yī kuài yī kuài de tōu zǒu。 dàn shì tiě chuí qiāo zhōng huì yǒu hěn dà de shēng yīn， suǒ yǒu rén dōu néng tīng jiàn， tā kěn dìng huì bèi fā xiàn。 tā yòu xiǎng le xiǎng： rú guǒ qiāo zhōng de shí hou bǎ zì jǐ de ěr duo wǔ qǐ lái， jiù shén me dōu tīng bù dào le！ tā jué de zì jǐ tīng bù dào shēng yīn， bié rén yě yī dìng tīng bù dào。 rán hòu tā yī biān wǔ ěr duo， yī biān yòng tiě chuí qiāo zhōng。 hěn duō rén dōu tīng dào le zhōng shēng， gǎn lái bǎ zhè gè xiǎo tōu zhuā zhù le。 zhè gè chéng yǔ jiù shì“ yǎn ěr dào líng”， wǒ men jīng cháng yòng zhè gè chéng yǔ lái bǐ yù zì jǐ piàn zì jǐ de xíng wéi。
english_paragraphs: Once upon a time, there was a man who saw a big clock at the door of someone else's house and wanted to steal it. But the bell was big and heavy, so he took a hammer and tried to break it into pieces, then steal it piece by piece. But the hammer striking the bell will make a loud sound that can be heard by everyone, and he will definitely be discovered. He thought again: If he covered his ears when ringing the bell, he would hear nothing! He felt that if he couldn't hear the sound, others wouldn't be able to hear it either. Then he struck the bell with a hammer while covering his ears. Many people heard the bell and came to catch the thief. This idiom is "hiding one's ears and stealing the bell". We often use this idiom to describe our behavior of deceiving ourselves.

13530.title: An E-mail
simplified_paragraphs: 昨天我收到了一封丹尼的邮件。丹尼是我大学时候的男朋友，大学毕业以后，我在中国工作，他去加拿大继续学习。分手之后，我们已经五年没有见面了。他在邮件中告诉我，下个月他会从加拿大回国，到北京之后希望能和我见面聊天。我一晚上没有睡觉，有点儿激动，有点儿担心，有点儿期待，有点儿害怕，心情很复杂。不知道他现在变成什么样子了？他还喜欢吃辣的东西吗？长胖了吗？结婚了吗？博士毕业了吗？生活得开心吗？虽然分手让人心碎，但是我们在一起的那几年非常快乐，所以我也希望他幸福。真想马上就到下个月啊！
traditional_paragraphs: 昨天我收到了一封丹尼的郵件。丹尼是我大學時候的男朋友，大學畢業以後，我在中國工作，他去加拿大繼續學習。分手之後，我們已經五年沒有見面了。他在郵件中告訴我，下個月他會從加拿大回國，到北京之後希望能和我見面聊天。我一晚上沒有睡覺，有點兒激動，有點兒擔心，有點兒期待，有點兒害怕，心情很複雜。不知道他現在變成什麼樣子了？他還喜歡吃辣的東西嗎？長胖了嗎？結婚了嗎？博士畢業了嗎？生活得開心嗎？雖然分手讓人心碎，但是我們在一起的那幾年非常快樂，所以我也希望他幸福。真想馬上就到下個月啊！

english_paragraphs: Yesterday I received an email from Danny. Danny was my boyfriend in college. After graduating from college, I worked in China and he went to Canada to continue his studies. After the breakup, we didn't see each other for five years. He told me in the email that he will return to China from Canada next month and hopes to meet and chat with me after arriving in Beijing. I didn't sleep all night. I was a little excited, a little worried, a little looking forward to it, a little scared, and my mood was very complicated. I wonder what he has become now? Does he still like spicy food? Have you gained weight? Married? Have you graduated with a PhD? Are you happy with your life? Although the breakup was heartbreaking, we had a very happy few years together, so I wanted him to be happy too. I really want to go to next month soon!

13540.title: Sun Ling’s struggle
simplified_paragraphs: 孙玲出生在湖南的国家级贫困县，家庭经济状态一直很困难。19岁时只有高中学历的她来到深圳，进入了一家电池厂，开始在流水线上工作。那时她每天工作12个小时，月薪只有2300元。
来到深圳后的第十个月，她省吃俭用，报了一个电脑培训班，学习一些基本的编程内容。后来孙玲说，那段日子很充实，她坚信学习可以改变现状。学完电脑课程以后，她找到了一份新的工作，工资更高，也更轻松一些。新工作开始后不久，她又报了一个英语培训班，一边工作，一边努力学习英语。之后，孙玲先后取得了计算机专业的大专文凭和专升本文凭。这时，她26岁，月薪过万了。
除了工作和学习，孙玲还积极发展自己的爱好。她学英语、玩飞盘、当博主，去过了更多的地方，也认识了更多的人。这些有趣的人让她有了去国外看看的念头。
2017年，孙玲看到一所美国学校的计算机硕士招生广告，而且学校会提供实习机会。虽然这不是特别好的学校，但是对于孙玲来说，这是一个机会，她很想抓住。七个月后，孙玲考过了雅思，拿到了去美国的学生签证。
孙玲来到美国，开始了她的学习。第一学期结束后，她开始找实习。两个月中，孙玲参加了60场面试，最后终于拿到了Google外包公司的工作机会。之后孙玲成为eBay员工，现在又被高盛录用。这一年，她30岁，年薪百万。
孙玲的这十年就像一个奇迹。学习能力很强的她凭借自己的努力，抓住每一个机会学习和进步，勇敢又能干。从普通厂妹到高薪程序员，这就是孙玲的奋斗之路。

pinyin_paragraphs: Sūn Líng chū shēng zài Hú Nán de guó jiā jí pín kùn xiàn， jiā tíng jīng jì zhuàng tài yī zhí hěn kùn nan。19 suì shí zhǐ yǒu gāo zhōng xué lì de tā lái dào Shēn zhèn， jìn rù le yī jiā diàn chí chǎng， kāi shǐ zài liú shuǐ xiàn shàng gōng zuò。 nà shí tā měi tiān gōng zuò 12 gè xiǎo shí， yuè xīn zhǐ yǒu 2300 yuán。

lái dào Shēn zhèn hòu de dì shí gè yuè， tā shěng chī jiǎn yòng， bào le yī gè diàn nǎo péi xùn bān， xué xí yī xiē jī běn de biān chéng nèi róng。 hòu lái Sūn Líng shuō， nà duàn rì zi hěn chōng shí， tā jiān xìn xué xí kě yǐ gǎi biàn xiàn zhuàng。 xué wán diàn nǎo kè chéng yǐ hòu， tā zhǎo dào le yī fèn xīn de gōng zuò， gōng zī gèng gāo， yě gèng qīng sōng yī xiē。 xīn gōng zuò kāi shǐ hòu bù jiǔ， tā yòu bào le yī gè Yīng yǔ péi xùn bān， yī biān gōng zuò， yī biān nǔ lì xué xí Yīng yǔ。 zhī hòu， Sūn Líng xiān hòu qǔ dé le jì suàn jī zhuān yè de dà zhuān wén píng hé zhuān shēng běn wén píng。 zhè shí， tā 26 suì， yuè xīn guò wàn le。

chú le gōng zuò hé xué xí， Sūn Líng hái jī jí fā zhǎn zì jǐ de ài hào。 tā xué Yīng yǔ、 wán fēi pán、 dāng bó zhǔ， qù guo le gèng duō de dì fang， yě rèn shi le gèng duō de rén。 zhè xiē yǒu qù de rén ràng tā yǒu le qù guó wài kàn kan de niàn tou。

2017 nián， Sūn Líng kàn dào yī suǒ Měi guó xué xiào de jì suàn jī shuò shì zhāo shēng guǎng gào， ér qiě xué xiào huì tí gōng shí xí jī huì。 suī rán zhè bù shì tè bié hǎo de xué xiào， dàn shì duì yú Sūn Líng lái shuō， zhè shì yī gè jī huì， tā hěn xiǎng zhuā zhù。 qī gè yuè hòu， Sūn Líng kǎo guò le Yǎ sī， ná dào le qù Měi guó de xué shēng qiān zhèng。

Sūn Líng lái dào Měi guó， kāi shǐ le tā de xué xí。 dì yī xué qī jié shù hòu， tā kāi shǐ zhǎo shí xí。 liǎng gè yuè zhōng， Sūn Líng cān jiā le 60 chǎng miàn shì， zuì hòu zhōng yú ná dào le Google wài bāo gōng sī de gōng zuò jī huì。 zhī hòu Sūn Líng chéng wéi eBay yuán gōng， xiàn zài yòu bèi Gāo shèng lù yòng。 zhè yī nián， tā 30 suì， nián xīn bǎi wàn。

Sūn Líng de zhè shí nián jiù xiàng yī gè qí jì。 xué xí néng lì hěn qiáng de tā píng jiè zì jǐ de nǔ lì， zhuā zhù měi yī gè jī huì xué xí hé jìn bù， yǒng gǎn yòu néng gàn。 cóng pǔ tōng chǎng mèi dào gāo xīn chéng xù yuán， zhè jiù shì Sūn Líng de fèn dòu zhī lù。
english_paragraphs: Ten months after arriving in Shenzhen, she saved her money and signed up for a computer training class to learn some basic programming content. Later, Sun Ling said that those days were very fulfilling and she firmly believed that learning could change the status quo. After finishing the computer course, she found a new job with a higher salary and easier work. Shortly after starting her new job, she signed up for an English training class and worked hard while learning English. After that, Sun Ling obtained a college diploma and a college-to-undergraduate diploma in computer science. At this time, she was 26 years old and had a monthly salary of over 10,000 yuan.

In addition to work and study, Sun Ling also actively develops her own hobbies. She learned English, played Frisbee, became a blogger, traveled to more places, and met more people. These interesting people gave her the idea to visit foreign countries.

In 2017, Sun Ling saw an advertisement for a master's degree in computer science from an American school, and the school would provide internship opportunities. Although this is not a particularly good school, for Sun Ling, this is an opportunity that she wants to seize. Seven months later, Sun Ling passed the IELTS test and obtained a student visa to the United States.

Sun Ling came to the United States and began her studies. After her first semester, she started looking for an internship. In two months, Sun Ling participated in 60 interviews and finally got a job opportunity from Google outsourcing company. Sun Ling later became an eBay employee and is now employed by Goldman Sachs. This year, she is 30 years old and has an annual salary of one million.

Sun Ling's ten years have been like a miracle. She has a strong learning ability and relies on her own efforts to seize every opportunity to learn and progress. She is brave and capable. From an ordinary factory girl to a high-paid programmer, this is Sun Ling's journey of struggle.

13440.title: Deaf lawyer
simplified_paragraphs: 第二次全国残疾人抽样调查数据显示，中国的听力残疾人达到2780万。2020年底，在这些听力残疾人中出现了中国第一位聋人律师，她的名字叫谭婷。
谭婷八岁时患上了中耳炎，但是因为不恰当的治疗，最后失去了听力，变成了聋人。她开始学习适应没有声音的世界，五年后，才进入特殊教育学校。谭婷的成长期是中国特殊教育刚开始发展的时候，全国各地有各种各样的特殊学校，教学质量、教材的使用等都参差不齐。但是谭婷很努力，把所有的时间都拿来学习，读到高中时，整个年级只剩四个人了。高考后，她成功考进了重庆师范大学的特殊教育专业，成为了那一年这个高中唯一的大学生。

按计划，谭婷可能会成为一名特殊教育老师。但是一个偶然的机会，她看到了招聘聋人作为律师助理的信息，这让她喜出望外，并定下了成为律师的目标。想要成为律师，必须通过国家司法考试。这个考试对于普通人来说都很难，通过率仅为10%，这对聋人的难度会更大。因为聋人对于很多常识的理解会比普通人更难。谭婷自从开始准备司法考试之后，每天早上六点学习到晚上十点。因为各种压力，和她一起准备考试的很多人都渐渐放弃了。谭婷失败了两次，终于在第三次通过了考试。
因为谭婷是聋人，所以她或许是中国40万律师里唯一不能上庭的。她的工作将主要集中在法庭下。她想让更多聋人有健全的法律知识，减少聋人们的困难。现在，她成为了聋人和普通人的桥梁，努力让更多聋人能“听见”。

pinyin_paragraphs: dì èr cì quán guó cán jí rén chōu yàng diào chá shù jù xiǎn shì， Zhōng guó de tīng lì cán jí rén dá dào 2780 wàn。2020 nián dǐ， zài zhè xiē tīng lì cán jí rén zhōng chū xiàn le Zhōng guó dì yī wèi lóng rén lǜ shī， tā de míng zi jiào Tán Tíng。

Tán Tíng bā suì shí huàn shàng le zhōng ěr yán， dàn shì yīn wèi bù qià dàng de zhì liáo， zuì hòu shī qù le tīng lì， biàn chéng le lóng rén。 tā kāi shǐ xué xí shì yìng méi yǒu shēng yīn de shì jiè， wǔ nián hòu， cái jìn rù tè shū jiào yù xué xiào。 Tán Tíng de chéng zhǎng qī shì Zhōng guó tè shū jiào yù gāng kāi shǐ fā zhǎn de shí hou， quán guó gè dì yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de tè shū xué xiào， jiào xué zhì liàng、 jiào cái de shǐ yòng děng dōu cēn cī bù qí。 dàn shì Tán Tíng hěn nǔ lì， bǎ suǒ yǒu de shí jiān dōu ná lái xué xí， dú dào gāo zhōng shí， zhěng gè nián jí zhǐ shèng sì gè rén le。 gāo kǎo hòu， tā chéng gōng kǎo jìn le Chóng qìng Shī fàn Dà xué de tè shū jiào yù zhuān yè， chéng wéi le nà yī nián zhè gè gāo zhōng wéi yī de dà xué shēng。

àn jì huà， Tán Tíng kě néng huì chéng wéi yī míng tè shū jiào yù lǎo shī。 dàn shì yī gè ǒu rán de jī huì， tā kàn dào le zhāo pìn lóng rén zuò wéi lǜ shī zhù lǐ de xìn xī， zhè ràng tā xǐ chū wàng wài， bìng dìng xià le chéng wéi lǜ shī de mù biāo。 xiǎng yào chéng wéi lǜ shī， bì xū tōng guò guó jiā sī fǎ kǎo shì。 zhè gè kǎo shì duì yú pǔ tōng rén lái shuō dōu hěn nán， tōng guò lǜ jǐn wéi 10%， zhè duì lóng rén de nán dù huì gèng dà。 yīn wèi lóng rén duì yú hěn duō cháng shí de lǐ jiě huì bǐ pǔ tōng rén gèng nán。 Tán Tíng zì cóng kāi shǐ zhǔn bèi sī fǎ kǎo shì zhī hòu， měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn xué xí dào wǎn shang shí diǎn。 yīn wèi gè zhǒng yā lì， hé tā yī qǐ zhǔn bèi kǎo shì de hěn duō rén dōu jiàn jiàn fàng qì le。 Tán Tíng shī bài le liǎng cì， zhōng yú zài dì sān cì tōng guò le kǎo shì。

yīn wèi Tán Tíng shì lóng rén， suǒ yǐ tā huò xǔ shì Zhōng guó 40 wàn lǜ shī lǐ wéi yī bù néng shàng tíng de。 tā de gōng zuò jiāng zhǔ yào jí zhōng zài fǎ tíng xià。 tā xiǎng ràng gèng duō lóng rén yǒu jiàn quán de fǎ lǜ zhī shi， jiǎn shǎo lóng rén men de kùn nan。 xiàn zài， tā chéng wéi le lóng rén hé pǔ tōng rén de qiáo liáng， nǔ lì ràng gèng duō lóng rén néng“ tīng jiàn”。
english_paragraphs: Data from the Second National Sample Survey of Disabled Persons show that the number of hearing disabled people in China reaches 27.8 million. At the end of 2020, China's first deaf lawyer appeared among these hearing disabled people. Her name is Tan Ting.

Tan Ting suffered from otitis media when she was eight years old, but due to improper treatment, she eventually lost her hearing and became deaf. She began to learn to adapt to a world without sounds, and five years later, she entered a special education school. Tan Ting's growth period was when special education in China was just beginning to develop. There were various special schools across the country, and the quality of teaching and the use of teaching materials were uneven. But Tan Ting worked very hard and spent all her time studying. By the time she reached high school, there were only four people left in the entire grade. After the college entrance examination, she successfully entered the special education major of Chongqing Normal University and became the only college student in the high school that year.

According to the plan, Tan Ting may become a special education teacher. But by chance, she saw information about recruiting deaf people as paralegals, which made her overjoyed and set her goal of becoming a lawyer. If you want to become a lawyer, you must pass the national judicial examination. This exam is difficult for ordinary people, with a passing rate of only 10%. It will be even more difficult for deaf people. Because it is more difficult for deaf people to understand many common sense than ordinary people. Since Tan Ting started preparing for the judicial examination, she studied from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day. Because of various pressures, many people preparing for the exam with her gradually gave up. Tan Ting failed twice and finally passed the exam on the third time.

Because Tan Ting is deaf, she may be the only one of the 400,000 lawyers in China who cannot go to court. Her work will primarily focus on the courtroom. She wants more deaf people to have sound legal knowledge and reduce the difficulties faced by deaf people. Now, she has become a bridge between deaf people and ordinary people, working hard to let more deaf people "hear".

13434.title: Yè Gōng hào lóng
simplified_paragraphs: 春秋时期，有一个人叫叶公，他非常喜欢龙。叶公家的大门、窗户、花园、石头、墙、家具全都有龙的图案。不但住的地方随时随地可以看到龙，他每天一有空就会写龙、画龙，连孩子们的名字都有“龙”。天上的龙被叶公感动了，决定到人间来见他，向他表示感谢。
有一天，叶公正在睡觉，屋子外面突然电闪雷鸣，风雨交加。叶公赶紧起来关窗户，这时候真正的龙从窗户外把头伸进来，他非常惊恐，转身往里跑，又看见一条巨大的龙尾巴。叶公发现自己无处可逃，就被吓晕了。龙看着晕倒的叶公，感到很失望，只好飞回天上去了。
后来人们用“叶公好龙”这个成语比喻一些人表里不一，看起来很喜欢某些东西，实际并不爱好，也不了解，甚至害怕它、反对它。
traditional_paragraphs: 春秋時期，有一個人叫葉公，他非常喜歡龍。葉公家的大門、窗戶、花園、石頭、牆、家具全都有龍的圖案。不但住的地方隨時隨地可以看到龍，他每天一有空就會寫龍、畫龍，連孩子們的名字都有“龍”。天上的龍被葉公感動了，決定到人間來見他，向他表示感謝。
有一天，葉公正在睡覺，屋子外面突然電閃雷鳴，風雨交加。葉公趕緊起來關窗戶，這時候真正的龍從窗戶外把頭伸進來，他非常驚恐，轉身往裡跑，又看見一條巨大的龍尾巴。葉公發現自己無處可逃，就被嚇暈了。龍看著暈倒的葉公，感到很失望，只好飛回天上去了。
後來人們用“葉公好龍”這個成語比喻一些人表裡不一，看起來很喜歡某些東西，實際並不愛好，也不瞭解，甚至害怕它、反對它。
pinyin_paragraphs: Chūn qiū shí qī， yǒu yī gè rén jiào Yè Gōng， tā fēi cháng xǐ huan lóng。 Yè Gōng jiā de dà mén、 chuāng hu、 huā yuán、 shí tou、 qiáng、 jiā jù quán dōu yǒu lóng de tú àn。 bù dàn zhù de dì fang suí shí suí dì kě yǐ kàn dào lóng， tā měi tiān yī yǒu kòng jiù huì xiě lóng、 huà lóng， lián hái zi men de míng zi dōu yǒu“ lóng”。 tiān shàng de lóng bèi Yè Gōng gǎn dòng le， jué dìng dào rén jiān lái jiàn tā， xiàng tā biǎo shì gǎn xiè。

yǒu yī tiān， Yè Gōng zhèng zài shuì jiào， wū zi wài miàn tū rán diàn shǎn léi míng， fēng yǔ jiāo jiā。 Yè Gōng gǎn jǐn qǐ lái guān chuāng hu， zhè shí hou zhēn zhèng de lóng cóng chuāng hu wài bǎ tóu shēn jìn lái， tā fēi cháng jīng kǒng， zhuǎn shēn wǎng lǐ pǎo， yòu kàn jiàn yī tiáo jù dà de lóng wěi ba。 Yè Gōng fā xiàn zì jǐ wú chù kě táo， jiù bèi xià yūn le。 lóng kàn zhe yūn dǎo de Yè Gōng， gǎn dào hěn shī wàng， zhǐ hǎo fēi huí tiān shàng qù le。
hòu lái rén men yòng“ Yè Gōng hào lóng” zhè gè chéng yǔ bǐ yù yī xiē rén biǎo lǐ bù yī， kàn qǐ lái hěn xǐ huan mǒu xiē dōng xi， shí jì bìng bù ài hào， yě bù liǎo jiě， shèn zhì hài pà tā、 fǎn duì tā。
english_paragraphs: During the Spring and Autumn Period, there was a man named Ye Gong who liked dragons very much. The doors, windows, gardens, stones, walls, and furniture of Ye Gong's house all have dragon patterns. Not only can you see dragons anytime and anywhere where he lives, he will write and draw dragons every day when he has free time. Even the names of his children have "dragon" in them. The dragon in the sky was moved by Ye Gong and decided to come to the world to see him and express his gratitude to him.

One day, while Ye Zhengzheng was sleeping, there was sudden thunder and lightning and wind and rain outside the house. Ye Gong quickly got up and closed the window. At this time, the real dragon stuck its head out of the window. He was very frightened, turned around and ran in, and saw a huge dragon tail again. When Ye Gong found that he had nowhere to escape, he was frightened and fainted. The dragon looked at the fainted Ye Gong and felt very disappointed, so he had to fly back to the sky.
Later, people used the idiom "Ye Gong loves dragons" to describe some people who seem to like something, but actually do not like it, do not understand it, or even fear it or oppose it.

13422.title: A day of my mother
simplified_paragraphs: 妈妈在图书馆工作。她每天早上六点起床，起床后给我和爸爸做早饭，然后我们一起吃。七点半，她会先送我去学校，然后再去工作。图书馆九点开门，她常常差一刻九点到图书馆门口。中午妈妈会在图书馆的食堂吃饭。晚上我们一起在家吃晚饭，有时候一起看电视。这是我妈妈的一天。
traditional_paragraphs: 媽媽在圖書館工作。她每天早上六點起床，起床後給我和爸爸做早飯，然後我們一起吃。七點半，她會先送我去學校，然後再去工作。圖書館九點開門，她常常差一刻九點到圖書館門口。中午媽媽會在圖書館的食堂吃飯。晚上我們一起在家吃晚飯，有時候一起看電視。這是我媽媽的一天。
pinyin_paragraphs: mā ma zài tú shū guǎn gōng zuò。 tā měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn qǐ chuáng， qǐ chuáng hòu gěi wǒ hé bà ba zuò zǎo fàn， rán hòu wǒ men yī qǐ chī。 qī diǎn bàn， tā huì xiān sòng wǒ qù xué xiào， rán hòu zài qù gōng zuò。 tú shū guǎn jiǔ diǎn kāi mén， tā cháng cháng chà yī kè jiǔ diǎn dào tú shū guǎn mén kǒu。 zhōng wǔ mā ma huì zài tú shū guǎn de shí táng chī fàn。 wǎn shang wǒ men yī qǐ zài jiā chī wǎn fàn， yǒu shí hou yī qǐ kàn diàn shì。 zhè shì wǒ mā ma de yī tiān。
english_paragraphs: Mom works in the library. She gets up at six o'clock every morning, makes breakfast for me and my father, and then we eat together. At half past seven, she would send me to school first and then go to work. The library opened at nine o'clock, and she often arrived at the library door a quarter before nine o'clock. At noon, my mother will eat in the library cafeteria. In the evening we have dinner together at home and sometimes watch TV together. This is my mom's day.

12779.title: Free nursing home
simplified_paragraphs: 河南的小伙子樊金林1997年出生，现在已经是四家养老院的院长了，也是国内粉丝最多的养老院院长。他大学毕业以后，在家人的支持下开了自己的第一家养老院。一个偶然的机会让他改变了想法，决定把自己的养老院变成免费的。一位老人曾对樊金林表示，希望能长期居住在养老院，并且希望费用可以便宜一点，老人也愿意为养老院和樊金林做点别的事情。这个请求让樊金林开始考虑创办一个免费的养老院。他计划投资120万元钱，让老人们免费住，但是这里的老人们需要拍摄一些视频，把免费养老院变成一个网红养老院，这些视频的收入可以帮助养老院的运营。樊金林还给老人们准备了一个电子游戏房，因为很多老人非常希望了解年轻人的东西。他认为，养老院也应该充满活力和欢笑。
traditional_paragraphs: 河南的小伙子樊金林1997年出生，現在已經是四家養老院的院長了，也是國內粉絲最多的養老院院長。他大學畢業以後，在家人的支持下開了自己的第一家養老院。一個偶然的機會讓他改變了想法，決定把自己的養老院變成免費的。一位老人曾對樊金林表示，希望能長期居住在養老院，並且希望費用可以便宜一點，老人也願意為養老院和樊金林做點別的事情。這個請求讓樊金林開始考慮創辦一個免費的養老院。他計劃投資120萬元錢，讓老人們免費住，但是這裡的老人們需要拍攝一些視頻，把免費養老院變成一個網紅養老院，這些視頻的收入可以幫助養老院的運營。樊金林還給老人們準備了一個電子遊戲房，因為很多老人非常希望瞭解年輕人的東西。他認為，養老院也應該充滿活力和歡笑。
pinyin_paragraphs: Hén án de xiǎo huǒ zi Fán Jīn lín 1997 nián chū shēng， xiàn zài yǐ jīng shì sì jiā yǎng lǎo yuàn de yuàn zhǎng le， yě shì guó nèi fěn sī zuì duō de yǎng lǎo yuàn yuàn zhǎng。 tā dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu， zài jiā rén de zhī chí xià kāi le zì jǐ de dì yī jiā yǎng lǎo yuàn。 yī gè ǒu rán de jī huì ràng tā gǎi biàn le xiǎng fǎ， jué dìng bǎ zì jǐ de yǎng lǎo yuàn biàn chéng miǎn fèi de。 yī wèi lǎo rén céng duì Fán Jīn lín biǎo shì， xī wàng néng cháng qī jū zhù zài yǎng lǎo yuàn， bìng qiě xī wàng fèi yong kě yǐ pián yi yī diǎn， lǎo rén yě yuàn yì wèi yǎng lǎo yuàn hé Fán Jīn lín zuò diǎn bié de shì qing。 zhè gè qǐng qiú ràng Fán Jīn lín kāi shǐ kǎo lǜ chuàng bàn yī gè miǎn fèi de yǎng lǎo yuàn。 tā jì huà tóu zī 120 wàn yuán qián， ràng lǎo rén men miǎn fèi zhù， dàn shì zhè lǐ de lǎo rén men xū yào pāi shè yī xiē shì pín， bǎ miǎn fèi yǎng lǎo yuàn biàn chéng yī gè wǎng hóng yǎng lǎo yuàn， zhè xiē shì pín de shōu rù kě yǐ bāng zhù yǎng lǎo yuàn de yùn yíng。 Fán Jīn lín hái gěi lǎo rén men zhǔn bèi le yī gè diàn zǐ yóu xì fáng， yīn wèi hěn duō lǎo rén fēi cháng xī wàng liǎo jiě nián qīng rén de dōng xi。 tā rèn wéi， yǎng lǎo yuàn yě yīng gāi chōng mǎn huó lì hé huān xiào。
english_paragraphs: Fan Jinlin, a young man from Henan, was born in 1997. He is now the director of four nursing homes and is also the director of the nursing home with the most fans in China. After graduating from college, he opened his first nursing home with the support of his family. An accidental opportunity made him change his mind and decided to make his nursing home free. An old man once expressed to Fan Jinlin that he hoped to live in a nursing home for a long time and that the cost could be cheaper. The old man was also willing to do other things for the nursing home and Fan Jinlin. This request made Fan Jinlin consider starting a free nursing home. He plans to invest 1.2 million yuan to let the elderly live for free, but the elderly here need to shoot some videos to turn the free nursing home into an Internet celebrity nursing home. The income from these videos can help the operation of the nursing home. Fan Jinlin also prepared a video game room for the elderly, because many elderly people really want to learn about young people's things. He believes that nursing homes should also be full of energy and laughter.

12765.title: Order takeaway
simplified_paragraphs: 我是一名医生，工作很忙。我不会做饭，一般也不在家里吃，下班以后经常去医院旁边的饭馆吃饭。后来，同事们告诉我，可以用手机点外卖，又方便又便宜。我试了一个星期，感觉太好了。我现在每顿都可以吃不同的东西，昨天吃饺子，今天吃面条，明天吃三明治，太幸福了！
traditional_paragraphs: 我是一名醫生，工作很忙。我不會做飯，一般也不在家裡吃，下班以後經常去醫院旁邊的飯館吃飯。後來，同事們告訴我，可以用手機點外賣，又方便又便宜。我試了一個星期，感覺太好了。我現在每頓都可以吃不同的東西，昨天吃餃子，今天吃麵條，明天吃三明治，太幸福了！

english_paragraphs: I am a doctor and very busy at work. I don't know how to cook, and I usually don't eat at home. After get off work, I often go to the restaurant next to the hospital to eat. Later, my colleagues told me that I could order takeout using my mobile phone, which was convenient and cheap. I tried it for a week and it felt great. I can now eat different things for every meal. Yesterday I had dumplings, today I have noodles, and tomorrow I have sandwiches. I’m so happy!

13547.title: Tuī Qiāo
simplified_paragraphs: 中文里很多词都是有典故的。“推敲”这个词的典故就源于唐代诗人贾岛。
有一次，贾岛骑驴去拜访朋友李凝的路上作了一首诗，其中有一句是“鸟宿池边树，僧敲月下门”。他反复读了几遍，不知道用“敲”更好，还是用“推”更好。他犹豫不决，在驴背上做推敲的姿势，路边的人们看到他的样子觉得又好笑又惊讶。贾岛正想得入神时，他的驴冲撞了别人的仪仗队。这个人就是韩愈，他当时是长安城最大的官员，也是唐代著名的文学家。
韩愈问贾岛为什么闯进自己的仪仗队。贾岛就把自己的诗念给韩愈听，并告诉了他自己对于“推”和“敲”这两个字的犹豫。韩愈听后，也开始认真思考。好一阵以后，他对贾岛说：“我看还是用‘敲’更好，即使夜深人静时拜访朋友，敲门代表你是一个有礼貌的人。而且这个‘敲’字在静夜里增添了几分声响。再说，读起来也更响亮些。”贾岛听了以后连连点头表示赞同。这回他不但没受到处罚，还和韩愈变成了朋友。
从此以后，“推敲”就成为了脍炙人口的常用词，用来比喻做事或者写文章时，反复琢磨，仔细斟酌。
我们一起来欣赏一下这首诗吧！
《题李凝幽居》
闲居少邻并，草径入荒原。
鸟宿池边树，僧敲月下门。
过桥分野色，移石动云根。
暂去还来此，幽期不负言。
traditional_paragraphs: 中文裡很多詞都是有典故的。“推敲”這個詞的典故就源於唐代詩人賈島。
有一次，賈島騎驢去拜訪朋友李凝的路上作了一首詩，其中有一句是“鳥宿池邊樹，僧敲月下門”。他反覆讀了幾遍，不知道用“敲”更好，還是用“推”更好。他猶豫不決，在驢背上做推敲的姿勢，路邊的人們看到他的樣子覺得又好笑又驚訝。賈島正想得入神時，他的驢衝撞了別人的儀仗隊。這個人就是韓愈，他當時是長安城最大的官員，也是唐代著名的文學家。
韓愈問賈島為什麼闖進自己的儀仗隊。賈島就把自己的詩念給韓愈聽，並告訴了他自己對於“推”和“敲”這兩個字的猶豫。韓愈聽後，也開始認真思考。好一陣以後，他對賈島說：“我看還是用‘敲’更好，即使夜深人靜時拜訪朋友，敲門代表你是一個有禮貌的人。而且這個‘敲’字在靜夜裡增添了幾分聲響。再說，讀起來也更響亮些。”賈島聽了以後連連點頭表示贊同。這回他不但沒受到處罰，還和韓愈變成了朋友。
從此以後，“推敲”就成為了膾炙人口的常用詞，用來比喻做事或者寫文章時，反覆琢磨，仔細斟酌。
我們一起來欣賞一下這首詩吧！
《題李凝幽居》
閒居少鄰並，草徑入荒原。
鳥宿池邊樹，僧敲月下門。
過橋分野色，移石動雲根。
暫去還來此，幽期不負言。
pinyin_paragraphs: Zhōng wén lǐ hěn duō cí dōu shì yǒu diǎn gù de。“ tuī qiāo” zhè gè cí de diǎn gù jiù yuán yú Táng dài shī rén Jiǎ Dǎo。

yǒu yī cì， Jiǎ Dǎo qí lǘ qù bài fǎng péng you Lǐ Níng de lù shang zuò le yī shǒu shī， qí zhōng yǒu yī jù shì“ niǎo sù chí biān shù， sēng qiāo yuè xià mén”。 tā fǎn fù dú le jǐ biàn， bù zhī dào yòng“ qiāo” gèng hǎo， hái shì yòng“ tuī” gèng hǎo。 tā yóu yù bù jué， zài lǘ bèi shàng zuò tuī qiāo de zī shì， lù bian de rén men kàn dào tā de yàng zi jué de yòu hǎo xiào yòu jīng yà。 Jiǎ Dǎo zhèng xiǎng de rù shén shí， tā de lǘ chōng zhuàng le bié rén de yí zhàng duì。 zhè gè rén jiù shì Hán Yù， tā dāng shí shì Cháng ān chéng zuì dà de guān yuán， yě shì Táng dài zhù míng de wén xué jiā。

Hán Yù wèn Jiǎ Dǎo wèi shén me chuǎng jìn zì jǐ de yí zhàng duì。 Jiǎ Dǎo jiù bǎ zì jǐ de shī niàn gěi Hán Yù tīng， bìng gào su le tā zì jǐ duì yú“ tuī” hé“ qiāo” zhè liǎng gè zì de yóu yù。 Hán Yù tīng hòu， yě kāi shǐ rèn zhēn sī kǎo。 hǎo yī zhèn yǐ hòu， tā duì Jiǎ Dǎo shuō：“ wǒ kàn hái shì yòng‘ qiāo’ gèng hǎo， jí shǐ yè shēn rén jìng shí bài fǎng péng you， qiāo mén dài biǎo nǐ shì yī gè yǒu lǐ mào de rén。 ér qiě zhè gè‘ qiāo’ zì zài jìng yè lǐ zēng tiān le jǐ fèn shēng xiǎng。 zài shuō， dú qǐ lái yě gèng xiǎng liàng xiē。” Jiǎ Dǎo tīng le yǐ hòu lián lián diǎn tóu biǎo shì zàn tóng。 zhè huí tā bù dàn méi shòu dào chǔ fá， hái hé Hán Yù biàn chéng le péng you。
cóng cǐ yǐ hòu，“ tuī qiāo” jiù chéng wéi le kuài zhì rén kǒu de cháng yòng cí， yòng lái bǐ yù zuò shì huò zhě xiě wén zhāng shí， fǎn fù zuó mo， zǐ xì zhēn zhuó。
wǒ men yī qǐ lái xīn shǎng yī xià zhè shǒu shī ba！

english_paragraphs: Once, Jia Dao wrote a poem while riding a donkey to visit his friend Li Ning. One of the lines was "The bird stayed in the tree by the pond, and the monk knocked on the door under the moon." He read it several times and didn't know whether it was better to use "knock" or "push". He hesitated and made a deliberation gesture on the donkey's back. People on the roadside were amused and surprised when they saw him. When Jia Dao was lost in thought, his donkey collided with someone else's honor guard. This man was Han Yu, who was the largest official in Chang'an City at the time and a famous writer in the Tang Dynasty.

Han Yu asked Jia Dao why he broke into his honor guard. Jia Dao read his poem to Han Yu and told him his hesitation about the words "push" and "knock". After hearing this, Han Yu also began to think seriously. After a while, he said to Jia Dao: "I think it is better to use 'knock'. Even if you are visiting friends in the dead of night, knocking on the door means that you are a polite person. Moreover, the word 'knock' adds a bit of sound in the quiet night. Besides, it sounds louder." Jia Dao nodded in agreement after hearing this. Not only was he not punished this time, but he also became friends with Han Yu.
Since then, "deliberation" has become a popular word used to describe thinking over and over again when doing something or writing an article.
Let’s enjoy this poem together!
"Inscribed on Li Ning's Residence in Seclusion"
Living leisurely with few neighbors, the grassy path leads into the wilderness.
The bird stayed in the tree beside the pond, and the monk knocked on the door under the moon.
Crossing the bridge, you can see the wild colors, and you can move rocks and cloud roots.
I've been away for a while and come back here, and I live up to my promise.

simplified_paragraphs: 我和家人们现在越来越喜欢出国旅游。我的哥哥喜欢去日本，因为他很喜欢日本文化。我的妈妈喜欢欧洲，因为欧洲有很多漂亮的城市。我的爸爸喜欢美国，因为那些国家公园的自然环境很美。我最喜欢泰国，很多泰国人都能说一点儿英语，去哪儿都很方便，还有漂亮的海和好吃的食物。泰国一直是夏天，这也是我最喜欢的季节。如果能一直在泰国生活就好了！

12234.title: Special Winter Olympic Torchbearer
simplified_paragraphs: 2022年北京冬奥会的火炬接力中有一位特别的火炬手，他叫栾玉帅，是一位快递小哥。栾玉帅来自东北农村，2015年进入物流行业成为一名快递员。因为勤快又吃苦耐劳，每天都能比别人多送几十单快递。2017年，他第一次跑完了马拉松比赛，从此以后每天坚持跑步，就连送快递的时候都绑着沙袋负重训练，把工作和训练完美结合在一起。去年北京半程马拉松比赛上，他得了非职业选手第一名，被网友称为“跑得最快的快递小哥”。栾玉帅就这样一路奔跑，从大街小巷跑到马拉松赛场，现在又跑上了冬奥会，梦想变成了现实。作为作出突出贡献的不平凡的普通人，他也是广大快递员的代表。
traditional_paragraphs: 2022年北京冬奧會的火炬接力中有一位特別的火炬手，他叫欒玉帥，是一位快遞小哥。欒玉帥來自東北農村，2015年進入物流行業成為一名快遞員。因為勤快又吃苦耐勞，每天都能比別人多送幾十單快遞。2017年，他第一次跑完了馬拉松比賽，從此以後每天堅持跑步，就連送快遞的時候都綁著沙袋負重訓練，把工作和訓練完美結合在一起。去年北京半程馬拉松比賽上，他得了非職業選手第一名，被網友稱為“跑得最快的快遞小哥”。欒玉帥就這樣一路奔跑，從大街小巷跑到馬拉松賽場，現在又跑上了冬奧會，夢想變成了現實。作為作出突出貢獻的不平凡的普通人，他也是廣大快遞員的代表。
pinyin_paragraphs: 2022 nián Běi jīng Dōng Ào huì de huǒ jù jiē lì zhōng yǒu yī wèi tè bié de huǒ jù shǒu， tā jiào Luán Yù shuài， shì yī wèi kuài dì xiǎo gē。 Luán Yù shuài lái zì Dōng běi nóng cūn，2015 nián jìn rù wù liú háng yè chéng wéi yī míng kuài dì yuán。 yīn wèi qín kuai yòu chī kǔ nài láo， měi tiān dōu néng bǐ bié rén duō sòng jǐ shí dān kuài dì。2017 nián， tā dì yī cì pǎo wán le mǎ lā sōng bǐ sài， cóng cǐ yǐ hòu měi tiān jiān chí pǎo bù， jiù lián sòng kuài dì de shí hou dōu bǎng zhe shā dài fù zhòng xùn liàn， bǎ gōng zuò hé xùn liàn wán měi jié hé zài yī qǐ。 qù nián Běi jīng bàn chéng mǎ lā sōng bǐ sài shàng， tā dé le fēi zhí yè xuǎn shǒu dì yī míng， bèi wǎng yǒu chēng wéi“ pǎo de zuì kuài de kuài dì xiǎo gē”。 Luán Yù shuài jiù zhè yàng yī lù bēn pǎo， cóng dà jiē xiǎo xiàng pǎo dào mǎ lā sōng sài chǎng， xiàn zài yòu pǎo shàng le Dōng Ào huì， mèng xiǎng biàn chéng le xiàn shí。 zuò wéi zuò chū tū chū gòng xiàn de bù píng fán de pǔ tōng rén， tā yě shì guǎng dà kuài dì yuán de dài biǎo。
english_paragraphs: There is a special torchbearer in the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics torch relay. His name is Luan Yushuai, a courier boy. Luan Yushuai comes from a rural area in Northeast China. He entered the logistics industry in 2015 and became a courier. Because of his diligence and hard work, he is able to deliver dozens more express delivery orders than others every day. In 2017, he ran a marathon for the first time. Since then, he has continued to run every day. Even when delivering express delivery, he trained with sandbags and weights, perfectly combining work and training. At last year's Beijing Half Marathon, he won first place among non-professional runners and was called "the fastest courier boy" by netizens. Luan Yushuai ran all the way, from the streets to the marathon, and now to the Winter Olympics, and his dream has become a reality. As an extraordinary ordinary person who has made outstanding contributions, he is also a representative of the majority of couriers.

12215.title: Me and Li
simplified_paragraphs: 我和小李是好朋友，我们经常见面。有时候我们一起吃饭，有时候一起去商店买东西，有时候小李帮助我学习汉语，有时候我帮助她学习英语。这个周日，我们准备一起运动。我喜欢打羽毛球，她喜欢游泳。我们想先打羽毛球，再去游泳，两个人都会很高兴。

13427.title: Where is the subway station？
simplified_paragraphs: A：不好意思，请问附近有地铁站吗？
B：最近的地铁站应该是世纪公园站，在商场旁边。
A：你知道怎么走吗？
B：从这条路一直往前走，穿过一个小花园，到花园后门左转，再过两个十字路口，你就能看到国家图书馆了，图书馆对面就是世纪公园的商场。商场附近应该有三、四个地铁站入口。
A：谢谢你！但是，你说得太快了，能再说一遍吗？
B：好吧……其实，你也可以打车到地铁站。

B：最近的地鐵站應該是世紀公園站，在商場旁邊。

B：從這條路一直往前走，穿過一個小花園，到花園後門左轉，再過兩個十字路口，你就能看到國家圖書館了，圖書館對面就是世紀公園的商場。商場附近應該有三、四個地鐵站入口。
A：謝謝你！但是，你說得太快了，能再說一遍嗎？
B：好吧……其實，你也可以打車到地鐵站。
pinyin_paragraphs: A： bù hǎo yì si， qǐng wèn fù jìn yǒu dì tiě zhàn ma？
B： zuì jìn de dì tiě zhàn yīng gāi shì shì jì gōng yuán zhàn， zài shāng chǎng páng biān。
A： nǐ zhī dào zěn me zǒu ma？

B： cóng zhè tiáo lù yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu， chuān guò yī gè xiǎo huā yuán， dào huā yuán hòu mén zuǒ zhuǎn， zài guò liǎng gè shí zì lù kǒu， nǐ jiù néng kàn dào guó jiā tú shū guǎn le， tú shū guǎn duì miàn jiù shì shì jì gōng yuán de shāng chǎng。 shāng chǎng fù jìn yīng gāi yǒu sān、 sì gè dì tiě zhàn rù kǒu。
A： xiè xie nǐ！ dàn shì， nǐ shuō de tài kuài le， néng zài shuō yī biàn ma？
B： hǎo ba …… qí shí， nǐ yě kě yǐ dǎ chē dào dì tiě zhàn。
english_paragraphs: A: Sorry, is there a subway station nearby?
B: The nearest subway station should be Century Park Station, next to the shopping mall.
A: Do you know how to get there?

B: Go straight ahead from this road, pass through a small garden, turn left at the back door of the garden, and after two more intersections, you will see the National Library. Opposite the library is the shopping mall in Century Park. There should be three or four subway station entrances near the mall.
A: Thank you! But you spoke too quickly. Can you say it again?
B: Okay... Actually, you can also take a taxi to the subway station.

simplified_paragraphs: 服务员：你好，请问你想喝点什么？这是菜单。
顾客：你家什么最受欢迎啊？有推荐吗？

顾客：我要一杯原味奶茶。
服务员：好的。要热的还是冰的？
顾客：冰的，去冰。
服务员：甜度有特别要求吗？我们有全糖、半糖、少糖、无糖。
顾客：少糖。
服务员：好的。还要加别的东西吗？
顾客：不用了。

顾客：不用了，谢谢。

english_paragraphs: Waiter: Hello, what would you like to drink? This is the menu.
Customer: What is the most popular thing in your home? Any recommendations?
Waiter: These are our special drinks, you can take a look.
Customer: I want a cup of original milk tea.
Waiter: OK. Want it hot or iced?
Customer: It’s iced. Remove the ice.
Waiter: Do you have any special requirements for sweetness? We have full sugar, half sugar, less sugar, and no sugar.
Customer: Less sugar.
Waiter: OK. Want to add something else?
Customer: No need.
Waiter: Do you have our membership card?
Waiter: Members enjoy half-price discount on their first cup of milk tea every Wednesday. Do you want to apply for a membership card? It's free, you can consider it.
Customer: No, thank you.
Waiter: Okay, that's okay. A cup of original iced milk tea, with no ice and less sugar, costs ten yuan in total.
Customer: Is it possible to pay via WeChat?
Waiter: Yes, this is a QR code, please scan it here.
Customer: Paid.
Waiter: OK, here is the receipt, please wait. (one minute later)
Waiter: Original milk tea No. 23 is ready.
Customer: My name is No. 23.
Waiter: Please take it and go slowly.
Customer: Thank you, bye.

11765.title: Ask for sick leave
simplified_paragraphs: 最近，王先生因为牙齿痛，预约了两天的牙科检查和治疗，还跟公司请了带薪病假。后来，牙科诊所因为安全检查的原因取消了王先生第一天的预约，而王先生自己把第二天的预约也取消了。虽然牙科预约都取消了，王先生却没有向公司申请取消病假，而是去了香港旅游，还在微信分享自己的旅游照片。公司发现了他在微信的旅游照片，要求他提供这两天的看病记录。因为王先生没有办法提供，公司认为他严重违反了公司的规定，把他开除了。
traditional_paragraphs: 最近，王先生因為牙齒痛，預約了兩天的牙科檢查和治療，還跟公司請了帶薪病假。後來，牙科診所因為安全檢查的原因取消了王先生第一天的預約，而王先生自己把第二天的預約也取消了。雖然牙科預約都取消了，王先生卻沒有向公司申請取消病假，而是去了香港旅遊，還在微信分享自己的旅遊照片。公司發現了他在微信的旅遊照片，要求他提供這兩天的看病記錄。因為王先生沒有辦法提供，公司認為他嚴重違反了公司的規定，把他開除了。
pinyin_paragraphs: zuì jìn， Wáng xiān sheng yīn wèi yá chǐ tòng， yù yuē le liǎng tiān de yá kē jiǎn chá hé zhì liáo， hái gēn gōng sī qǐng le dài xīn bìng jià。 hòu lái， yá kē zhěn suǒ yīn wèi ān quán jiǎn chá de yuán yīn qǔ xiāo le Wáng xiān sheng dì yī tiān de yù yuē， ér Wáng xiān sheng zì jǐ bǎ dì èr tiān de yù yuē yě qǔ xiāo le。 suī rán yá kē yù yuē dōu qǔ xiāo le， Wáng xiān sheng què méi yǒu xiàng gōng sī shēn qǐng qǔ xiāo bìng jià， ér shì qù le Xiāng gǎng lǚ yóu， hái zài Wēi xìn fēn xiǎng zì jǐ de lǚ yóu zhào piàn。 gōng sī fā xiàn le tā zài Wēi xìn de lǚ yóu zhào piàn， yāo qiú tā tí gōng zhè liǎng tiān de kàn bìng jì lù。 yīn wèi Wáng xiān sheng méi yǒu bàn fǎ tí gōng， gōng sī rèn wéi tā yán zhòng wéi fǎn le gōng sī de guī dìng， bǎ tā kāi chú le。
english_paragraphs: Recently, Mr. Wang made an appointment for two days of dental examination and treatment due to tooth pain, and also requested paid sick leave from the company. Later, the dental clinic canceled Mr. Wang’s appointment on the first day due to safety inspection, and Mr. Wang himself also canceled the appointment on the second day. Although all dental appointments were cancelled, Mr. Wang did not apply to the company to cancel his sick leave. Instead, he traveled to Hong Kong and shared his travel photos on WeChat. The company discovered his travel photos on WeChat and asked him to provide his medical records for the past two days. Because Mr. Wang had no way to provide it, the company believed that he had seriously violated the company's regulations and fired him.

11751.title: The family of teachers
simplified_paragraphs: 广州市有一个中学的数学老师叫吴晖晖，她已经当老师29年了。她的爷爷是中国著名的教育家，她的爸爸、妈妈都是老师，一生都在做乡村教育。吴老师的其他家人中，有三十多人都在不同的城市做教育工作。她自己的女儿现在也在当老师。一家四代人都相信，教育是伟大的事业，这也是他们一生的追求。
traditional_paragraphs: 廣州市有一個中學的數學老師叫吳暉暉，她已經當老師29年了。她的爺爺是中國著名的教育家，她的爸爸、媽媽都是老師，一生都在做鄉村教育。吳老師的其他家人中，有三十多人都在不同的城市做教育工作。她自己的女兒現在也在當老師。一家四代人都相信，教育是偉大的事業，這也是他們一生的追求。

english_paragraphs: There is a middle school mathematics teacher in Guangzhou named Wu Huihui. She has been a teacher for 29 years. Her grandfather is a famous educator in China, and her father and mother are both teachers and have been engaged in rural education all their lives. More than 30 other members of Teacher Wu’s family are working in education in different cities. Her own daughter is now a teacher. Four generations of the family believe that education is a great cause and it is also their lifelong pursuit.

9900.title: Wait for the rabbit under the tree
simplified_paragraphs: 古时候，有个农民正在田里劳动。突然，他看见一只兔子从旁边的草丛里慌慌张张地跑出来，一头撞在田边的大树上，便倒在那儿一动也不动了。农民走过去一看：兔子死了。因为它奔跑的速度太快，把脖子都撞断了。农民高兴极了，他一点力气没花，就白捡了一只又肥又大的兔子。他心想：要是天天都能捡到兔子，那日子就好过了。从此，他再也不肯出力气劳动了。每天他吃完饭就躺在大树底下，等待着第二只、第三只兔子自己撞到树上来。世上哪有那么多便宜的事啊。这个农民当然再也没有捡到撞死的兔子，而他的田里也没有收获任何粮食，农民只好饿着肚子过年了。这个故事就是我们熟悉的成语“守株待兔”。
traditional_paragraphs: 古時候，有個農民正在田裡勞動。突然，他看見一隻兔子從旁邊的草叢裡慌慌張張地跑出來，一頭撞在田邊的大樹上，便倒在那兒一動也不動了。農民走過去一看：兔子死了。因為它奔跑的速度太快，把脖子都撞斷了。農民高興極了，他一點力氣沒花，就白撿了一隻又肥又大的兔子。他心想：要是天天都能撿到兔子，那日子就好過了。從此，他再也不肯出力氣勞動了。每天他吃完飯就躺在大樹底下，等待著第二隻、第三隻兔子自己撞到樹上來。世上哪有那麼多便宜的事啊。這個農民當然再也沒有撿到撞死的兔子，而他的田裡也沒有收穫任何糧食，農民只好餓著肚子過年了。這個故事就是我們熟悉的成語“守株待兔”。
pinyin_paragraphs: gǔ shí hou， yǒu gè nóng mín zhèng zài tián lǐ láo dòng。 tū rán， tā kàn jiàn yī zhī tù zi cóng páng biān de cǎo cóng lǐ huāng huāng zhāng zhāng de pǎo chu lai， yī tóu zhuàng zài tián biān de dà shù shàng， biàn dǎo zài nà r yī dòng yě bù dòng le。 nóng mín zǒu guò qù yī kàn： tù zi sǐ le。 yīn wèi tā bēn pǎo de sù dù tài kuài， bǎ bó zi dōu zhuàng duàn le。 nóng mín gāo xìng jí le， tā yī diǎn lì qi méi huā， jiù bái jiǎn le yī zhī yòu féi yòu dà de tù zi。 tā xīn xiǎng： yào shi tiān tiān dōu néng jiǎn dào tù zi， nà rì zi jiù hǎo guò le。 cóng cǐ， tā zài yě bù kěn chū lì qi láo dòng le。 měi tiān tā chī wán fàn jiù tǎng zài dà shù dǐ xia， děng dài zhe dì èr zhī、 dì sān zhī tù zi zì jǐ zhuàng dào shù shàng lái。 shì shàng nǎ yǒu nà me duō pián yi de shì a。 zhè gè nóng mín dāng rán zài yě méi yǒu jiǎn dào zhuàng sǐ de tù zi， ér tā de tián lǐ yě méi yǒu shōu huò rèn hé liáng shi， nóng mín zhǐ hǎo è zhe dù zi guò nián le。 zhè gè gù shi jiù shì wǒ men shú xi de chéng yǔ“ shǒu zhū dài tù”。
english_paragraphs: Long ago, a farmer was working in his field. Suddenly, he saw a rabbit dash out of the nearby grass in a panic and run headfirst into a large tree at the edge of the field. It fell to the ground and lay completely still. The farmer went over to look: the rabbit was dead. It had been running so fast that the impact broke its neck. The farmer was delighted. Without lifting a finger, he had got himself a big, fat rabbit. He thought, “If I could find a rabbit every day, life would be so much easier.” From then on, he refused to do any more work. Every day after eating, he lay beneath the tree, waiting for a second rabbit, then a third, to run into it. But how often does something like that happen? Of course, the farmer never found another rabbit that had run into the tree and died. He harvested no grain from his field either, so he had to spend the New Year hungry. This is the story behind the familiar Chinese idiom “守株待兔”—waiting by a tree stump for a rabbit.

9889.title: Unpredictable life
simplified_paragraphs: 人的一生，就像乘坐一辆公交车。我们知道它有起点和终点，却无法预知沿途的经历。有的人行程长，有的人行程短。有的人很从容，可以欣赏窗外的景色。有的人很窘迫，总处于拥挤之中。要想获得舒适与优雅，需要好的心情。
有的人很幸运，一上车就有座。有的人很倒霉，即使全车的人都坐下了，他还站着。有时别处的座位不断空出来，唯独身边这个毫无动静。而当他下定决心走向别处，刚才那个座位的人却正好离开。有的人用了种种的方式，经历了长长的等待，终于可以坐下，但这时他已经到站了。
traditional_paragraphs: 人的一生，就像乘坐一輛公交車。我們知道它有起點和終點，卻無法預知沿途的經歷。有的人行程長，有的人行程短。有的人很從容，可以欣賞窗外的景色。有的人很窘迫，總處於擁擠之中。要想獲得舒適與優雅，需要好的心情。

4726.title: One of my afternoons
simplified_paragraphs: 我想今天下午去看电影，但是没有好电影。我就打电话给我的好朋友，想和她一起去运动，但是她说今天身体不舒服，我们只能去商场买东西了。我们看见一条漂亮的裙子，她喜欢白色，我喜欢黑色，但是黑色的裙子有点儿贵，所以我买了两条白色的，一条给自己，一条送给她

11134.title: Live and learn
simplified_paragraphs: 今年6月，家住上海的一位老人获得了中国美术学院的双学士学位，从中国画专业顺利毕业。老人名叫徐安玲，1951年出生，今年已经70岁了。
徐安玲现在还清楚地记得自己上大学的第一天。她走进教室时，一群二十多岁的年轻学生都以为她走错教室了，甚至有人以为她是哪位同学的家长。进入大学以后，繁重的学习带给她很大的压力。别的年轻学生每天练习3-4小时，她只能靠更勤奋的练习来弥补自己的不足。她永远是班上第一个到教室，最后一个离开的人。
她从小就喜欢用铅笔画画，参加工作以后忙碌的工作生活让她放下了画笔，但是这个爱好一直没变。退休后，在她58岁那年，她重新拿起了画笔。现在她终于顺利毕业了。家人们也都很支持她退休之后追寻梦想的做法。她也将自己的一部分作品留给家乡，因为那是自己的梦开始的地方。
traditional_paragraphs: 今年6月，家住上海的一位老人獲得了中國美術學院的雙學士學位，從中國畫專業順利畢業。老人名叫徐安玲，1951年出生，今年已經70歲了。
徐安玲現在還清楚地記得自己上大學的第一天。她走進教室時，一群二十多歲的年輕學生都以為她走錯教室了，甚至有人以為她是哪位同學的家長。進入大學以後，繁重的學習帶給她很大的壓力。別的年輕學生每天練習3-4小時，她只能靠更勤奮的練習來彌補自己的不足。她永遠是班上第一個到教室，最後一個離開的人。
她從小就喜歡用鉛筆畫畫，參加工作以後忙碌的工作生活讓她放下了畫筆，但是這個愛好一直沒變。退休後，在她58歲那年，她重新拿起了畫筆。現在她終於順利畢業了。家人們也都很支持她退休之後追尋夢想的做法。她也將自己的一部分作品留給家鄉，因為那是自己的夢開始的地方。
pinyin_paragraphs: jīn nián 6 yuè， jiā zhù Shàng hǎi de yī wèi lǎo rén huò dé le Zhōng guó Měi shù Xué yuàn de shuāng xué shì xué wèi， cóng Zhōng guó huà zhuān yè shùn lì bì yè。 lǎo rén míng jiào Xú Ān líng，1951 nián chū shēng， jīn nián yǐ jīng 70 suì le。

Xú Ān líng xiàn zài hái qīng chu de jì de zì jǐ shàng dà xué de dì yī tiān。 tā zǒu jìn jiào shì shí， yī qún èr shí duō suì de nián qīng xué shēng dōu yǐ wéi tā zǒu cuò jiào shì le， shèn zhì yǒu rén yǐ wéi tā shì něi wèi tóng xué de jiā zhǎng。 jìn rù dà xué yǐ hòu， fán zhòng de xué xí dài gěi tā hěn dà de yā lì。 bié de nián qīng xué shēng měi tiān liàn xí 3-4 xiǎo shí， tā zhǐ néng kào gèng qín fèn de liàn xí lái mí bǔ zì jǐ de bù zú。 tā yǒng yuǎn shì bān shàng dì yī gè dào jiào shì， zuì hòu yī gè lí kāi de rén。

tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huan yòng qiān bǐ huà huà， cān jiā gōng zuò yǐ hòu máng lù de gōng zuò shēng huó ràng tā fàng xià le huà bǐ， dàn shì zhè gè ài hào yī zhí méi biàn。 tuì xiū hòu， zài tā 58 suì nà nián， tā chóng xīn ná qǐ le huà bǐ。 xiàn zài tā zhōng yú shùn lì bì yè le。 jiā rén men yě dōu hěn zhī chí tā tuì xiū zhī hòu zhuī xún mèng xiǎng de zuò fǎ。 tā yě jiāng zì jǐ de yī bù fen zuò pǐn liú gěi jiā xiāng， yīn wèi nà shì zì jǐ de mèng kāi shǐ de dì fang。
english_paragraphs: Xu Anling still clearly remembers her first day in college. When she walked into the classroom, a group of young students in their twenties thought she was in the wrong classroom. Some even thought she was the parent of a certain classmate. After entering college, the heavy study put a lot of pressure on her. Other young students practice 3-4 hours a day, but she can only make up for her shortcomings by practicing more diligently. She was always the first one in class to arrive and the last one to leave.

She has been fond of drawing with pencils since she was a child. After joining the workforce, her busy work life made her put down her painting brush, but this hobby has never changed. After retiring, at the age of 58, she took up painting again. Now she has finally graduated successfully. Her family also supports her pursuit of her dreams after retirement. She also left some of her works to her hometown, because that is where her dreams began.

11905.title: Genius girl Gu Ailing
simplified_paragraphs: 谷爱凌是2022北京冬奥会的一颗明星。她是天才滑雪少女，中国人最关注的焦点之一。

作为一个中美混血，谷爱凌出生于美国加州。妈妈是中国人，爸爸是美国人。因为妈妈喜欢滑雪，曾经是滑雪教练，所以她从三岁开始就接触滑雪了。2011年，谷爱凌开始学习自由式滑雪，并加入专业滑雪队。十三岁就开始参加成人比赛，一年时间获得了50枚金牌，十五岁时拿到了世界杯金牌，并登上国际雪联总积分榜榜首，可谓是不折不扣的天才滑雪运动员。当然，天才的背后是辛苦的努力和汗水，她也因为训练受过无数的伤痛，最终坚持下来赢得各种胜利。她用实力让周围的质疑变成了掌声。
除了是滑雪明星，谷爱凌也是学霸。2020年以SAT1580分的优秀成绩被斯坦福大学录取。她说，边滑雪边学习，这事对谁都是很难的，所以要先把百分之百的精力投入到学习上，解决完学习的事情之后，再百分之百投入到体育运动，这样两个事情就都能处理好了。

因为谷爱凌的妈妈对于她的中国文化教育很重视，所以两岁开始每年暑假都要回到北京，一直学习中文，现在能说一口流利的普通话。也因为家庭的教育和熏陶，她也从心里认同自己的中国人身份，因此，2019年她放弃美国国籍，加入了中国国籍，成为中国国家滑雪队的一员。谷爱凌回到中国，代表中国参加各种比赛，也希望通过自己的例子，将滑雪运动传播得更远。同时也让更多的女孩们看到，女性也可以参加极限运动，女性也可以做到如此优秀，鼓舞更多的女孩。
traditional_paragraphs: 谷愛凌是2022北京冬奧會的一顆明星。她是天才滑雪少女，中國人最關注的焦點之一。

作為一個中美混血，谷愛凌出生於美國加州。媽媽是中國人，爸爸是美國人。因為媽媽喜歡滑雪，曾經是滑雪教練，所以她從三歲開始就接觸滑雪了。2011年，谷愛凌開始學習自由式滑雪，並加入專業滑雪隊。十三歲就開始參加成人比賽，一年時間獲得了50枚金牌，十五歲時拿到了世界杯金牌，並登上國際雪聯總積分榜榜首，可謂是不折不扣的天才滑雪運動員。當然，天才的背後是辛苦的努力和汗水，她也因為訓練受過無數的傷痛，最終堅持下來贏得各種勝利。她用實力讓周圍的質疑變成了掌聲。
除了是滑雪明星，谷愛凌也是學霸。2020年以SAT1580分的優秀成績被斯坦福大學錄取。她說，邊滑雪邊學習，這事對誰都是很難的，所以要先把百分之百的精力投入到學習上，解決完學習的事情之後，再百分之百投入到體育運動，這樣兩個事情就都能處理好了。

因為谷愛凌的媽媽對於她的中國文化教育很重視，所以兩歲開始每年暑假都要回到北京，一直學習中文，現在能說一口流利的普通話。也因為家庭的教育和薰陶，她也從心裡認同自己的中國人身份，因此，2019年她放棄美國國籍，加入了中國國籍，成為中國國家滑雪隊的一員。谷愛凌回到中國，代表中國參加各種比賽，也希望通過自己的例子，將滑雪運動傳播得更遠。同時也讓更多的女孩們看到，女性也可以參加極限運動，女性也可以做到如此優秀，鼓舞更多的女孩。
pinyin_paragraphs: Gǔ Ài líng shì 2022 Běi jīng Dōng Ào huì de yī kē míng xīng。 tā shì tiān cái huá xuě shào nǚ， Zhōng guó rén zuì guān zhù de jiāo diǎn zhī yī。

zuò wéi yī gè Zhōng Měi hùn xuè， Gǔ Ài líng chū shēng yú Měi guó Jiā zhōu。 mā ma shì Zhōng guó rén， bà ba shì Měi guó rén。 yīn wèi mā ma xǐ huan huá xuě， céng jīng shì huá xuě jiào liàn， suǒ yǐ tā cóng sān suì kāi shǐ jiù jiē chù huá xuě le。2011 nián， Gǔ Ài líng kāi shǐ xué xí zì yóu shì huá xuě， bìng jiā rù zhuān yè huá xuě duì。 shí sān suì jiù kāi shǐ cān jiā chéng rén bǐ sài， yī nián shí jiān huò dé le 50 méi jīn pái， shí wǔ suì shí ná dào le Shì jiè bēi jīn pái， bìng dēng shàng guó jì Xuě Lián zǒng jī fēn bǎng bǎng shǒu， kě wèi shì bù zhé bù kòu de tiān cái huá xuě yùn dòng yuán。 dāng rán， tiān cái de bèi hòu shì xīn kǔ de nǔ lì hé hàn shuǐ， tā yě yīn wèi xùn liàn shòu guò wú shù de shāng tòng， zuì zhōng jiān chí xià lái yíng dé gè zhǒng shèng lì。 tā yòng shí lì ràng zhōu wéi de zhì yí biàn chéng le zhǎng shēng。

chú le shì huá xuě míng xīng， Gǔ Ài líng yě shì xué bà。2020 nián yǐ SAT1580 fēn de yōu xiù chéng jì bèi Sī tǎn fú Dà xué lù qǔ。 tā shuō， biān huá xuě biān xué xí， zhè shì duì shéi dōu shì hěn nán de， suǒ yǐ yào xiān bǎ bǎi fēn zhī bǎi de jīng lì tóu rù dào xué xí shàng， jiě jué wán xué xí de shì qing zhī hòu， zài bǎi fēn zhī bǎi tóu rù dào tǐ yù yùn dòng， zhè yàng liǎng gè shì qing jiù dōu néng chǔ lǐ hǎo le。

yīn wèi Gǔ Ài líng de mā ma duì yú tā de Zhōng guó wén huà jiào yù hěn zhòng shì， suǒ yǐ liǎng suì kāi shǐ měi nián shǔ jià dōu yào huí dào Běi jīng， yī zhí xué xí Zhōng wén， xiàn zài néng shuō yī kǒu liú lì de pǔ tōng huà。 yě yīn wèi jiā tíng de jiào yù hé xūn táo， tā yě cóng xīn lǐ rèn tóng zì jǐ de Zhōng guó rén shēn fèn， yīn cǐ，2019 nián tā fàng qì Měi guó guó jí， jiā rù le Zhōng guó guó jí， chéng wéi Zhōng guó guó jiā huá xuě duì de yī yuán。 Gǔ Ài líng huí dào Zhōng guó， dài biǎo Zhōng guó cān jiā gè zhǒng bǐ sài， yě xī wàng tōng guò zì jǐ de lì zi， jiāng huá xuě yùn dòng chuán bō de gèng yuǎn。 tóng shí yě ràng gèng duō de nǚ hái men kàn dào， nǚ xìng yě kě yǐ cān jiā jí xiàn yùn dòng， nǚ xìng yě kě yǐ zuò dào rú cǐ yōu xiù， gǔ wǔ gèng duō de nǚ hái。
english_paragraphs: Gu Ailing is a star at the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics. She is a talented ski girl and one of the focuses of Chinese people's attention.

In addition to being a skiing star, Gu Ailing is also a top student. In 2020, he was admitted to Stanford University with an excellent SAT score of 1580. She said that it is difficult for everyone to study while skiing, so she must devote 100% of her energy to studying first. After solving the study problems, she can then devote 100% to sports, so that both tasks can be taken care of.

Because Gu Ailing's mother attaches great importance to her Chinese cultural education, she has returned to Beijing every summer since she was two years old and has been studying Chinese. Now she can speak fluent Mandarin. Because of her family’s education and influence, she also recognized her Chinese identity from the bottom of her heart. Therefore, in 2019, she gave up her American citizenship, became a Chinese national, and became a member of the Chinese National Ski Team. Gu Ailing returned to China to represent China in various competitions and hoped to spread skiing further through her own example. At the same time, it also allows more girls to see that women can also participate in extreme sports, and that women can also be so good, inspiring more girls.

6368.title: My marriage
simplified_paragraphs: 刚结婚的时候，我只是一个普通的医生，我丈夫还是个中学老师，每天生活都很规律，我们俩每天早上起床后，一起吃早餐，看新闻，然后一起出门上班，生活很幸福。十年过去了，现在他已经是校长了，我也成为了医院的主任，我们的职位越来越高，工作也越来越忙，每天早上我起床后都看不到他，晚上我回家的时候他已经睡了。我们一起吃饭、交流的机会越来越少，偶尔见面，也不知道应该说什么了。曾经希望我们可以少一些会议，多一些休息，可以像以前一样经常在一起，但是大家都不愿意放弃自己的事业，最后我们只能离婚了。
traditional_paragraphs: 剛結婚的時候，我只是一個普通的醫生，我丈夫還是個中學老師，每天生活都很規律，我們倆每天早上起床後，一起吃早餐，看新聞，然後一起出門上班，生活很幸福。十年過去了，現在他已經是校長了，我也成為了醫院的主任，我們的職位越來越高，工作也越來越忙，每天早上我起床後都看不到他，晚上我回家的時候他已經睡了。我們一起吃飯、交流的機會越來越少，偶爾見面，也不知道應該說什麼了。曾經希望我們可以少一些會議，多一些休息，可以像以前一樣經常在一起，但是大家都不願意放棄自己的事業，最後我們只能離婚了。
pinyin_paragraphs: gāng jié hūn de shí hou， wǒ zhǐ shì yī gè pǔ tōng de yī shēng， wǒ zhàng fu hái shì gè zhōng xué lǎo shī， měi tiān shēng huó dōu hěn guī lǜ， wǒ men liǎ měi tiān zǎo shang qǐ chuáng hòu， yī qǐ chī zǎo cān， kàn xīn wén， rán hòu yī qǐ chū mén shàng bān， shēng huó hěn xìng fú。 shí nián guò qù le， xiàn zài tā yǐ jīng shì xiào zhǎng le， wǒ yě chéng wéi le yī yuàn de zhǔ rèn， wǒ men de zhí wèi yuè lái yuè gāo， gōng zuò yě yuè lái yuè máng， měi tiān zǎo shang wǒ qǐ chuáng hòu dōu kàn bù dào tā， wǎn shang wǒ huí jiā de shí hou tā yǐ jīng shuì le。 wǒ men yī qǐ chī fàn、 jiāo liú de jī huì yuè lái yuè shǎo， ǒu ěr jiàn miàn， yě bù zhī dào yīng gāi shuō shén me le。 céng jīng xī wàng wǒ men kě yǐ shǎo yī xiē huì yì， duō yī xiē xiū xi， kě yǐ xiàng yǐ qián yī yàng jīng cháng zài yī qǐ， dàn shì dà jiā dōu bù yuàn yì fàng qì zì jǐ de shì yè， zuì hòu wǒ men zhǐ néng lí hūn le。
english_paragraphs: When we first got married, I was just an ordinary doctor, and my husband was a middle school teacher. Our daily life was very regular. After we got up every morning, we would have breakfast together, watch the news, and then go to work together. We lived a very happy life. Ten years have passed, and now he is the principal and I have become the director of the hospital. Our positions are getting higher and higher, and our work is getting busier and busier. I can't see him when I get up every morning. When I go home at night, he is already asleep. We have fewer and fewer opportunities to eat and communicate together. When we meet occasionally, we don’t know what to say anymore. I once hoped that we could have fewer meetings, more rest, and be together as often as before, but no one was willing to give up their careers, so in the end we had no choice but to divorce.

10036.title: The right direction
simplified_paragraphs: 从前，有一个人要从魏国到楚国去。他带了很多钱，雇了好车和快马，请了很优秀的车夫，就上路了。楚国在魏国的南面，可这个人却让车夫驾着马车一直向北走。

路上有人问他要往哪儿去，他大声回答说：“去楚国！”路人告诉他说：“到楚国去应该往南方走，你这是往北走，方向不对。”那人不在乎地说：“没关系，我的马快着呢。”路人替他着急，拉住他的马，阻止他说：“方向错了，你的马再快，也到不了楚国呀。”那人依然不以为然：“不要紧，我带的钱多着呢。”路人又劝阻他说：“虽说你的钱多，可是你走的不是那个方向，你的钱也只能是白花呀。”那人有些不耐烦地说：“这有什么难的，我的车夫驾车的本领高着呢。”路人无奈，只好看着他走了。
那个魏国人，觉得自己的马快、钱多、车夫好，就朝着相反方向一意孤行。那么，他条件越好，他就只会离他要去的地方越远，因为他的方向是错的。这个故事告诉我们，无论做什么事，都首先要找到正确的方向，才能充分发挥自己的有利条件；如果方向错了，那么有利条件只会起到相反的作用。
traditional_paragraphs: 從前，有一個人要從魏國到楚國去。他帶了很多錢，雇了好車和快馬，請了很優秀的車夫，就上路了。楚國在魏國的南面，可這個人卻讓車夫駕著馬車一直向北走。

路上有人問他要往哪兒去，他大聲回答說：“去楚國！”路人告訴他說：“到楚國去應該往南方走，你這是往北走，方向不對。”那人不在乎地說：“沒關係，我的馬快著呢。”路人替他著急，拉住他的馬，阻止他說：“方向錯了，你的馬再快，也到不了楚國呀。”那人依然不以為然：“不要緊，我帶的錢多著呢。”路人又勸阻他說：“雖說你的錢多，可是你走的不是那個方向，你的錢也只能是白花呀。”那人有些不耐煩地說：“這有什麼難的，我的車夫駕車的本領高著呢。”路人無奈，只好看著他走了。
那個魏國人，覺得自己的馬快、錢多、車夫好，就朝著相反方向一意孤行。那麼，他條件越好，他就只會離他要去的地方越遠，因為他的方向是錯的。這個故事告訴我們，無論做什麼事，都首先要找到正確的方向，才能充分發揮自己的有利條件；如果方向錯了，那麼有利條件只會起到相反的作用。
pinyin_paragraphs: cóng qián， yǒu yī gè rén yào cóng Wèi guó dào Chǔ guó qù。 tā dài le hěn duō qián， gù le hǎo chē hé kuài mǎ， qǐng le hěn yōu xiù de chē fū， jiù shàng lù le。 Chǔ guó zài Wèi guó de nán miàn， kě zhè gè rén què ràng chē fū jià zhe mǎ chē yī zhí xiàng běi zǒu。

lù shàng yǒu rén wèn tā yào wǎng nǎ r qù， tā dà shēng huí dá shuō：“ qù Chǔ guó！” lù rén gào su tā shuō：“ dào Chǔ guó qù yīng gāi wǎng nán fāng zǒu， nǐ zhè shì wǎng běi zǒu， fāng xiàng bù duì。” nà rén bù zài hu de shuō：“ méi guān xi， wǒ de mǎ kuài zhe ne。” lù rén tì tā zháo jí， lā zhù tā de mǎ， zǔ zhǐ tā shuō：“ fāng xiàng cuò le， nǐ de mǎ zài kuài， yě dào bù liǎo Chǔ guó ya。” nà rén yī rán bù yǐ wéi rán：“ bù yào jǐn， wǒ dài de qián duō zhe ne。” lù rén yòu quàn zǔ tā shuō：“ suī shuō nǐ de qián duō， kě shì nǐ zǒu de bù shì nà gè fāng xiàng， nǐ de qián yě zhǐ néng shì bái huā ya。” nà rén yǒu xiē bù nài fán de shuō：“ zhè yǒu shén me nán de， wǒ de chē fū jià chē de běn lǐng gāo zhe ne。” lù rén wú nài， zhǐ hǎo kàn zhe tā zǒu le。

nà gè Wèi guó rén， jué de zì jǐ de mǎ kuài、 qián duō、 chē fū hǎo， jiù cháo zhe xiāng fǎn fāng xiàng yī yì gū xíng。 nà me， tā tiáo jiàn yuè hǎo， tā jiù zhǐ huì lí tā yào qù de dì fang yuè yuǎn， yīn wèi tā de fāng xiàng shì cuò de。 zhè gè gù shi gào su wǒ men， wú lùn zuò shén me shì， dōu shǒu xiān yào zhǎo dào zhèng què de fāng xiàng， cái néng chōng fèn fā huī zì jǐ de yǒu lì tiáo jiàn； rú guǒ fāng xiàng cuò le， nà me yǒu lì tiáo jiàn zhǐ huì qǐ dào xiāng fǎn de zuò yòng。
english_paragraphs: Someone on the road asked him where he was going, and he replied loudly: "To Chu State!" A passerby told him: "To go to Chu State, you should go south. You are going north, which is the wrong direction." The man said nonchalantly: "It doesn't matter, my horse is going fast." The passerby was worried for him, pulled his horse, and stopped him, saying: "The direction is wrong. No matter how fast your horse is, you can't get there. Chu State." The man still disagreed: "It doesn't matter, I have a lot of money." The passerby tried to dissuade him and said, "Although you have a lot of money, if you don't go in that direction, your money will be wasted." The man said impatiently, "What's the problem? My driver is very good at driving." The passerby had no choice but to watch him go.

The Wei man felt that his horse was fast, his money was rich, and his driver was good, so he went in the opposite direction. Then, the better his conditions, the further away he will be from where he wants to go, because his direction is wrong. This story tells us that no matter what we do, we must first find the right direction in order to give full play to our advantages; if we go in the wrong direction, the advantages will only have the opposite effect.

4622.title: Too many hobbies
simplified_paragraphs: 小杨今年8岁，常常让爸爸妈妈不高兴。他说他想学画画，每个星期天妈妈都不休息，和他一起坐车到学校去。可是只学了两个月，他说画画不容易，不想学了。他又说想学唱歌，爸爸就请老师来家里教他，现在刚学了一个月，他就说唱歌也没意思。爱好太多，但是不能坚持。现在爸爸妈妈不知道怎么办了，是不是别的孩子也这样呢？

english_paragraphs: Xiao Yang is 8 years old this year and often makes his parents unhappy. He said he wanted to learn to draw, and his mother would take a car to school with him every Sunday. But after only two months of learning, he said that painting was not easy and he didn’t want to learn it anymore. He also said that he wanted to learn to sing, so his father invited a teacher to come to his home to teach him. Now that he has just learned it for a month, he says that singing is boring. I have too many hobbies, but I can’t stick to them. Now parents don’t know what to do. Are other children like this too?

5430.title: Colour
simplified_paragraphs: 普通人可能很难理解颜色的重要性。十二岁的小男孩Jonathan有严重的色盲，他的校长把自己的眼镜借给男孩戴以后，小男孩哭起来。原来他的校长也有色盲，这是为色盲特别制作的眼镜，这是小男孩第一次看清楚不同的颜色，原来有颜色的世界是这样的。

5456.title: Twenty years later
simplified_paragraphs: 最近上海的一位妈妈因为女儿不认真写作业生气到抓狂，但是妈妈的生气却让她的父亲母亲很开心。
原来23年前，这位妈妈的爸爸辅导她作业时就遇到了同样的事情，女儿不认真写作业因此写了一封信给女儿，信里说：以后有一天你也会成为父母，将来你的孩子发生你现在这样的问题，你会怎么做呢？
traditional_paragraphs: 最近上海的一位媽媽因為女兒不認真寫作業生氣到抓狂，但是媽媽的生氣卻讓她的父親母親很開心。
原來23年前，這位媽媽的爸爸輔導她作業時就遇到了同樣的事情，女兒不認真寫作業因此寫了一封信給女兒，信裡說：以後有一天你也會成為父母，將來你的孩子發生你現在這樣的問題，你會怎麼做呢？

yuán lái 23 nián qián， zhè wèi mā ma de bà ba fǔ dǎo tā zuò yè shí jiù yù dào le tóng yàng de shì qing， nǚ ér bù rèn zhēn xiě zuò yè yīn cǐ xiě le yī fēng xìn gěi nǚ ér， xìn lǐ shuō： yǐ hòu yǒu yī tiān nǐ yě huì chéng wéi fù mǔ， jiāng lái nǐ de hái zi fā shēng nǐ xiàn zài zhè yàng de wèn tí， nǐ huì zěn me zuò ne？
english_paragraphs: Recently, a mother in Shanghai was so angry that her daughter didn't do her homework seriously that she went crazy. However, the mother's anger made her parents very happy.

It turns out that 23 years ago, this mother's father encountered the same thing when he was helping her with her homework. Her daughter didn't do her homework seriously, so he wrote a letter to her. The letter said: One day you will also become a parent. In the future, your child will have the same problem as you do now. What will you do?

4551.title: My good friend
simplified_paragraphs: 我的好朋友名字叫陈陈。他喜欢喝酒，我喜欢运动。小学和中学，我们都是一个班的同学。大学我们不在一个学校，但是我们还在一个城市生活。后来他去了杭州工作，我去了上海，但是我们还是经常见面。

4980.title: Prepare for travel
simplified_paragraphs: 下个月我想去旅游，但是还没想好去哪儿。朋友觉得北方好玩，但是下个月北方太冷了，南方好一些，不冷也不热。旅游的时候水果、面包、手机、电脑、地图，我都想带去。朋友说应该少带一些东西，因为这是旅游，不是搬家。但是我还是想多带一些衣服，这样每天都可以穿漂亮的衣服照相。
traditional_paragraphs: 下個月我想去旅遊，但是還沒想好去哪兒。朋友覺得北方好玩，但是下個月北方太冷了，南方好一些，不冷也不熱。旅遊的時候水果、麵包、手機、電腦、地圖，我都想帶去。朋友說應該少帶一些東西，因為這是旅遊，不是搬家。但是我還是想多帶一些衣服，這樣每天都可以穿漂亮的衣服照相。

english_paragraphs: I want to travel next month, but I haven’t decided where to go yet. My friend thinks the north is fun, but it will be too cold next month. The south is better, neither cold nor hot. When I travel, I want to take fruits, bread, mobile phones, computers, and maps with me. My friend said that I should bring less stuff with me because this is a trip, not a move. But I still want to bring more clothes so that I can wear beautiful clothes and take photos every day.

1127.title: Dad and mom are not at home
simplified_paragraphs: 今天爸爸妈妈不在家，我和弟弟妹妹在家。
妹妹想喝可乐，吃米饭；弟弟想喝茶，吃面条；我想喝咖啡，吃面包。但是我不会做米饭和面条，他们不喜欢面包，这是个问题。
爸爸妈妈什么时候回家呢？
traditional_paragraphs: 今天爸爸媽媽不在家，我和弟弟妹妹在家。
妹妹想喝可樂，吃米飯；弟弟想喝茶，吃麵條；我想喝咖啡，吃麵包。但是我不會做米飯和麵條，他們不喜歡麵包，這是個問題。
爸爸媽媽什麼時候回家呢？

mèi mei xiǎng hē kě lè， chī mǐ fàn； dì di xiǎng hē chá， chī miàn tiáo； wǒ xiǎng hē kā fēi， chī miàn bāo。 dàn shì wǒ bù huì zuò mǐ fàn hé miàn tiáo， tā men bù xǐ huan miàn bāo， zhè shì gè wèn tí。
bà ba mā ma shén me shí hou huí jiā ne？

When will mom and dad come home?

5028.title: Reading
simplified_paragraphs: 很多人把学习当任务，他们没有什么热情学习书里的知识。他们喜欢出去玩或者在家看电视，而不是坐在桌子前读书。但我却喜欢读书，书让我了解世界，了解不同的文化，知道不同的人，学习不同的知识。读书带给我很多快乐。
traditional_paragraphs: 很多人把學習當任務，他們沒有什麼熱情學習書裡的知識。他們喜歡出去玩或者在家看電視，而不是坐在桌子前讀書。但我卻喜歡讀書，書讓我瞭解世界，瞭解不同的文化，知道不同的人，學習不同的知識。讀書帶給我很多快樂。
pinyin_paragraphs: hěn duō rén bǎ xué xí dàng rèn wu， tā men méi yǒu shén me rè qíng xué xí shū lǐ de zhī shi。 tā men xǐ huan chū qù wán huò zhě zài jiā kàn diàn shì， ér bù shì zuò zài zhuō zi qián dú shū。 dàn wǒ què xǐ huan dú shū， shū ràng wǒ liǎo jiě shì jiè， liǎo jiě bù tóng de wén huà， zhī dào bù tóng de rén， xué xí bù tóng de zhī shi。 dú shū dài gěi wǒ hěn duō kuài lè。
english_paragraphs: Many people regard learning as a task, and they have no enthusiasm for learning the knowledge in books. They prefer to go out and play or watch TV at home instead of sitting at the table and reading. But I like reading. Books allow me to understand the world, different cultures, different people, and learn different knowledge. Reading brings me a lot of happiness.

6494.title: Fill the bottle
simplified_paragraphs: 孩子们因为琐事打了起来。妈妈就把一个大玻璃瓶子拿出来，瓶子里装着满满的石头、玻璃碎片和沙子。之后，妈妈让孩子们把瓶子里的东西都倒出来，然后再装进去，先从沙子开始。
每个孩子都试了试，最后都发现没有足够的空间装所有的石头。
妈妈指导孩子们重新装这个瓶子。这次，先从石头开始，最后再装沙子。石头装进去后，沙子就沉积在石头的周围，最后，所有东西都装进瓶子里了。
妈妈说：“如果我们先从小的东西开始，把小东西装进去之后，大的石头就放不进去了。生活也是如此，如果你的生活先被不重要的事挤满了，那你就无法再装进更大、更重要的事了。”
traditional_paragraphs: 孩子們因為瑣事打了起來。媽媽就把一個大玻璃瓶子拿出來，瓶子裡裝著滿滿的石頭、玻璃碎片和沙子。之後，媽媽讓孩子們把瓶子裡的東西都倒出來，然後再裝進去，先從沙子開始。
每個孩子都試了試，最後都發現沒有足夠的空間裝所有的石頭。
媽媽指導孩子們重新裝這個瓶子。這次，先從石頭開始，最後再裝沙子。石頭裝進去後，沙子就沉積在石頭的周圍，最後，所有東西都裝進瓶子裡了。
媽媽說：“如果我們先從小的東西開始，把小東西裝進去之後，大的石頭就放不進去了。生活也是如此，如果你的生活先被不重要的事擠滿了，那你就無法再裝進更大、更重要的事了。”
pinyin_paragraphs: hái zi men yīn wèi suǒ shì dǎ le qǐ lái。 mā ma jiù bǎ yī gè dà bō li píng zi ná chu lai， píng zi lǐ zhuāng zhe mǎn mǎn de shí tou、 bō li suì piàn hé shā zi。 zhī hòu， mā ma ràng hái zi men bǎ píng zi lǐ de dōng xi dōu dào chu lai， rán hòu zài zhuāng jìn qù， xiān cóng shā zi kāi shǐ。
měi gè hái zi dōu shì le shì， zuì hòu dōu fā xiàn méi yǒu zú gòu de kōng jiān zhuāng suǒ yǒu de shí tou。

mā ma zhǐ dǎo hái zi men chóng xīn zhuāng zhè gè píng zi。 zhè cì， xiān cóng shí tou kāi shǐ， zuì hòu zài zhuāng shā zi。 shí tou zhuāng jìn qù hòu， shā zi jiù chén jī zài shí tou de zhōu wéi， zuì hòu， suǒ yǒu dōng xi dōu zhuāng jìn píng zi lǐ le。

mā ma shuō：“ rú guǒ wǒ men xiān cóng xiǎo de dōng xi kāi shǐ， bǎ xiǎo dōng xi zhuāng jìn qù zhī hòu， dà de shí tou jiù fàng bù jìn qù le。 shēng huó yě shì rú cǐ， rú guǒ nǐ de shēng huó xiān bèi bù zhòng yào de shì jǐ mǎn le， nà nǐ jiù wú fǎ zài zhuāng jìn gèng dà、 gèng zhòng yào de shì le。”
english_paragraphs: The children got into fights over trivial matters. Mom took out a large glass bottle filled with rocks, glass fragments and sand. After that, the mother asked the children to pour everything out of the bottle and then put it back in, starting with the sand.
Each child tried it, but each found that there was not enough room for all the rocks.

The mother instructs the children to refill the bottle. This time, start with rocks and finish with sand. Once the stone is in, the sand settles around it, and eventually, everything is in the bottle.

Mom said: "If we start with the small things first, after the small things are put in, the big rocks will not fit in. The same is true in life. If your life is filled with unimportant things first, then you will not be able to put in bigger and more important things."

4889.title: Dancing
simplified_paragraphs: 张老师最近有了一个新学生，她是个八岁的小女孩，她的妈妈带着她来学跳舞。上课一个月以后，老师发现这个女孩每次上课都不笑。原来是这个女孩的妈妈逼她来学跳舞，但是小女孩不喜欢。老师问这个妈妈为什么一定要让孩子学跳舞？这个妈妈说，因为她从小就觉得会跳舞的人都很美，所以想让孩子来学。老师说：那么下次孩子就不用来了，她不喜欢，也不快乐，喜欢跳舞的是你，你才应该来当我的学生。
traditional_paragraphs: 張老師最近有了一個新學生，她是個八歲的小女孩，她的媽媽帶著她來學跳舞。上課一個月以後，老師發現這個女孩每次上課都不笑。原來是這個女孩的媽媽逼她來學跳舞，但是小女孩不喜歡。老師問這個媽媽為什麼一定要讓孩子學跳舞？這個媽媽說，因為她從小就覺得會跳舞的人都很美，所以想讓孩子來學。老師說：那麼下次孩子就不用來了，她不喜歡，也不快樂，喜歡跳舞的是你，你才應該來當我的學生。
pinyin_paragraphs: Zhāng lǎo shī zuì jìn yǒu le yī gè xīn xué shēng， tā shì gè bā suì de xiǎo nǚ hái， tā de mā ma dài zhe tā lái xué tiào wǔ。 shàng kè yī gè yuè yǐ hòu， lǎo shī fā xiàn zhè gè nǚ hái měi cì shàng kè dōu bù xiào。 yuán lái shì zhè gè nǚ hái de mā ma bī tā lái xué tiào wǔ， dàn shì xiǎo nǚ hái bù xǐ huan。 lǎo shī wèn zhè gè mā ma wèi shén me yī dìng yào ràng hái zi xué tiào wǔ？ zhè gè mā ma shuō， yīn wèi tā cóng xiǎo jiù jué de huì tiào wǔ de rén dōu hěn měi， suǒ yǐ xiǎng ràng hái zi lái xué。 lǎo shī shuō： nà me xià cì hái zi jiù bù yòng lái le， tā bù xǐ huan， yě bù kuài lè， xǐ huan tiào wǔ de shì nǐ， nǐ cái yīng gāi lái dāng wǒ de xué shēng。
english_paragraphs: Teacher Zhang recently had a new student. She is an eight-year-old girl. Her mother took her to learn to dance. After a month of class, the teacher discovered that the girl never smiled every time she attended class. It turned out that the girl's mother forced her to learn dancing, but the little girl didn't like it. The teacher asked this mother why she had to let her child learn to dance? The mother said that since she was a child, she thought people who could dance were beautiful, so she wanted her children to learn. The teacher said: Then the child will not come next time. She does not like it and is not happy. It is you who likes to dance, and you should be my student.

4702.title: Change of life
simplified_paragraphs: 为了学习汉语，我来到了中国生活。到了新环境意味着我不得不放弃很多东西，比如我亲爱的老朋友和美丽的风景。首先，我必须学会适应陌生的环境。当我有时间，我就会在街上走，熟悉商店和街道。然后我发现了一些有趣的地方，比如一些小咖啡店。小店提供了很多书，我可以在里面看书。我没有多少朋友，我有点孤独，但是我的同学都很好，他们帮助我解决问题。现在我有了很多好朋友，感觉在中国就像在家一样。我会在这里找到更多的惊喜。

english_paragraphs: In order to learn Chinese, I came to live in China. Arriving in a new environment meant that I had to give up a lot of things, such as my dear old friends and the beautiful scenery. First, I must learn to adapt to a strange environment. When I have time, I walk on the streets and get familiar with the shops and streets. Then I found some interesting places, like some little coffee shops. The store provides a lot of books, and I can read in them. I don't have many friends and I'm a bit lonely, but my classmates are very nice and they help me solve my problems. Now I have many good friends and feel like I am at home in China. I will find more surprises here.

4452.title: My Chinese teacher
simplified_paragraphs: 因为工作需要，我必须学习汉语，但是学习了一段时间以后，我觉得汉语越来越难，有点儿无聊，不想学了。上个月，一个新的汉语老师来教我，我发现她的方法很不一样。她会让我听中文歌，看中文电影和新闻，我们也会一起讨论很多关于中国的问题。我现在对汉语又有兴趣了。
traditional_paragraphs: 因為工作需要，我必須學習漢語，但是學習了一段時間以後，我覺得漢語越來越難，有點兒無聊，不想學了。上個月，一個新的漢語老師來教我，我發現她的方法很不一樣。她會讓我聽中文歌，看中文電影和新聞，我們也會一起討論很多關於中國的問題。我現在對漢語又有興趣了。

english_paragraphs: Because of my work needs, I have to learn Chinese, but after studying for a while, I felt that Chinese was getting more and more difficult, a bit boring, and I didn’t want to learn it anymore. Last month, a new Chinese teacher came to teach me, and I found that her approach was very different. She would let me listen to Chinese songs, watch Chinese movies and news, and we would discuss many issues about China together. I am now interested in Chinese again.

4558.title: Me
simplified_paragraphs: 我从大学毕业以后，第一份工作是在公司里当职员，后来我发现生活太无聊了，整天坐在办公室里，所以我决定辞职。辞职以后我去了很多地方，开阔了视野，遇见了很多人，看到了很多风景。当我遇见我现在的丈夫，我知道是时候安定下来了，然后回家找了一份适合我的工作。
traditional_paragraphs: 我從大學畢業以後，第一份工作是在公司裡當職員，後來我發現生活太無聊了，整天坐在辦公室裡，所以我決定辭職。辭職以後我去了很多地方，開闊了視野，遇見了很多人，看到了很多風景。當我遇見我現在的丈夫，我知道是時候安定下來了，然後回家找了一份適合我的工作。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ cóng dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu， dì yī fèn gōng zuò shì zài gōng sī lǐ dāng zhí yuán， hòu lái wǒ fā xiàn shēng huó tài wú liáo le， zhěng tiān zuò zài bàn gōng shì lǐ， suǒ yǐ wǒ jué dìng cí zhí。 cí zhí yǐ hòu wǒ qù le hěn duō dì fang， kāi kuò le shì yě， yù jiàn le hěn duō rén， kàn dào le hěn duō fēng jǐng。 dāng wǒ yù jiàn wǒ xiàn zài de zhàng fu， wǒ zhī dào shì shí hou ān dìng xià lái le， rán hòu huí jiā zhǎo le yī fèn shì hé wǒ de gōng zuò。
english_paragraphs: After I graduated from college, my first job was as a clerk in a company. Later, I found that life was too boring, sitting in the office all day, so I decided to quit. After resigning, I went to many places, broadened my horizons, met many people, and saw many scenery. When I met my now husband, I knew it was time to settle down and go home and find a job that suited me.

4253.title: Three Doctoral Brothers
simplified_paragraphs: 兄弟三人都是博士，并且都从事太空研究工作。一天，三兄弟和自己的妻子去母亲家里吃饭，吃完后，他们就开始讨论有关太空研究的问题。
妻子们和母亲在厨房洗碗，其中一个妻子说："他们讨论的事是我完全不懂的，听着会让我觉得自己很笨。”母亲却讲了一段话，使大家恢复了自信。她说："刚开始我也觉得自己很笨，可是有一次，他们花了两个小时才做了一碗非常不好吃的面条。从那以后，我就不再那么想了，因为每个人都有自己的长处和短处。”
traditional_paragraphs: 兄弟三人都是博士，並且都從事太空研究工作。一天，三兄弟和自己的妻子去母親家裡吃飯，吃完後，他們就開始討論有關太空研究的問題。
妻子們和母親在廚房洗碗，其中一個妻子說："他們討論的事是我完全不懂的，聽著會讓我覺得自己很笨。”母親卻講了一段話，使大家恢復了自信。她說："剛開始我也覺得自己很笨，可是有一次，他們花了兩個小時才做了一碗非常不好吃的麵條。從那以後，我就不再那麼想了，因為每個人都有自己的長處和短處。”
pinyin_paragraphs: xiōng dì sān rén dōu shì bó shì， bìng qiě dōu cóng shì tài kōng yán jiū gōng zuò。 yī tiān， sān xiōng dì hé zì jǐ de qī zi qù mǔ qīn jiā lǐ chī fàn， chī wán hòu， tā men jiù kāi shǐ tǎo lùn yǒu guān tài kōng yán jiū de wèn tí。

qī zi men hé mǔ qīn zài chú fáng xǐ wǎn， qí zhōng yī gè qī zi shuō：" tā men tǎo lùn de shì shì wǒ wán quán bù dǒng de， tīng zhe huì ràng wǒ jué de zì jǐ hěn bèn。” mǔ qīn què jiǎng le yī duàn huà， shǐ dà jiā huī fù le zì xìn。 tā shuō：" gāng kāi shǐ wǒ yě jué de zì jǐ hěn bèn， kě shì yǒu yī cì， tā men huā le liǎng gè xiǎo shí cái zuò le yī wǎn fēi cháng bù hǎo chī de miàn tiáo。 cóng nà yǐ hòu， wǒ jiù bù zài nà me xiǎng le， yīn wèi měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de cháng chù hé duǎn chù。”
english_paragraphs: All three brothers have Ph.D.s and are engaged in space research. One day, the three brothers and their wives went to their mother's house for dinner. After eating, they began to discuss issues related to space research.

The wives and their mothers were washing dishes in the kitchen. One of the wives said, "I don't understand what they are discussing at all. It makes me feel stupid." But the mother said something that restored everyone's confidence. She said: "I thought I was stupid at first, but once, it took them two hours to make a bowl of noodles that was very unpalatable. From then on, I stopped thinking that way, because everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses."

4474.title: Shoulder
simplified_paragraphs: 我很小的时候认为身体最重要的部位是眼睛，因为眼睛可以看见蓝天、看见白云、看见我们爱的人。奶奶说：这个世界上有很多盲人啊。
后来我开始学习音乐，我认为身体最重要的部位是耳朵或者嘴，因为耳朵可以听到世界上最美的声音，嘴可以唱出好听的歌。爷爷说：但这个世界也有很多聋哑人。
几年以后，我好朋友的爸爸去世了，她非常伤心，我陪着她度过了那段不开心的日子。回家以后，妈妈对我说：现在，你知道最重要的部位是哪了吗？没错，是肩膀。因为在我们爱的人哭泣的时候，肩膀可以让他们依靠。我们每个人都需要肩膀，我们自己也要有强壮肩膀留给别人。

hòu lái wǒ kāi shǐ xué xí yīn yuè， wǒ rèn wéi shēn tǐ zuì zhòng yào de bù wèi shì ěr duo huò zhě zuǐ， yīn wèi ěr duo kě yǐ tīng dào shì jiè shàng zuì měi de shēng yīn， zuǐ kě yǐ chàng chū hǎo tīng de gē。 yé ye shuō： dàn zhè gè shì jiè yě yǒu hěn duō lóng yǎ rén。

jǐ nián yǐ hòu， wǒ hǎo péng you de bà ba qù shì le， tā fēi cháng shāng xīn， wǒ péi zhe tā dù guò le nà duàn bù kāi xīn de rì zi。 huí jiā yǐ hòu， mā ma duì wǒ shuō： xiàn zài， nǐ zhī dào zuì zhòng yào de bù wèi shì nǎ le ma？ méi cuò， shì jiān bǎng。 yīn wèi zài wǒ men ài de rén kū qì de shí hou， jiān bǎng kě yǐ ràng tā men yī kào。 wǒ men měi gè rén dōu xū yào jiān bǎng， wǒ men zì jǐ yě yào yǒu qiáng zhuàng jiān bǎng liú gěi bié rén。
english_paragraphs: When I was very young, I thought that the most important part of the body was the eyes, because the eyes can see the blue sky, white clouds, and the people we love. Grandma said: There are many blind people in the world.

Later I started studying music. I think the most important part of the body is the ears or the mouth, because the ears can hear the most beautiful sounds in the world, and the mouth can sing beautiful songs. Grandpa said: But there are also many deaf-mute people in this world.

A few years later, my good friend's father passed away. She was very sad. I stayed with her through those unhappy days. After returning home, my mother said to me: Now, do you know where the most important part is? Yes, it's the shoulder. Because a shoulder is there for our loved ones to cry on when they cry. Each of us needs shoulders, and we must also have strong shoulders for others.

4296.title: Philosophy of Life in Porcelain
simplified_paragraphs: 去旅游时,我买了一件珍贵的瓷器。瓷器用大箱子装着，大箱子里的间隙塞满了废纸，我考虑到大箱子携带不方便，就扔掉了大箱子和里面的废纸，直接把瓷器放进了我的行李箱中。
上车时，由于不小心，我的行李箱重重地摔到了地上。打开行李箱一看，那件珍贵的瓷器已经碎了。这时我才后悔扔掉了那些看起来好像没用的废纸。
其实没有什么东西是完全没用的，哪怕是那些废纸，在某些方面，它们也有着自己独特的功能。只要用到合适的地方，废纸也能发挥重要的作用。所以，不要看轻别人，看轻那些"废纸”，因为任何事物都有自己的价值。
traditional_paragraphs: 去旅遊時,我買了一件珍貴的瓷器。瓷器用大箱子裝著，大箱子裡的間隙塞滿了廢紙，我考慮到大箱子攜帶不方便，就扔掉了大箱子和裡面的廢紙，直接把瓷器放進了我的行李箱中。

其實沒有什麼東西是完全沒用的，哪怕是那些廢紙，在某些方面，它們也有著自己獨特的功能。只要用到合適的地方，廢紙也能發揮重要的作用。所以，不要看輕別人，看輕那些"廢紙”，因為任何事物都有自己的價值。
pinyin_paragraphs: qù lǚ yóu shí , wǒ mǎi le yī jiàn zhēn guì de cí qì。 cí qì yòng dà xiāng zi zhuāng zhe， dà xiāng zi lǐ de jiàn xì sāi mǎn le fèi zhǐ， wǒ kǎo lǜ dào dà xiāng zi xié dài bù fāng biàn， jiù rēng diào le dà xiāng zi hé lǐ miàn de fèi zhǐ， zhí jiē bǎ cí qì fàng jìn le wǒ de xíng li xiāng zhōng。

shàng chē shí， yóu yú bù xiǎo xīn， wǒ de xíng li xiāng zhòng zhòng de shuāi dào le dì shàng。 dǎ kāi xíng li xiāng yī kàn， nà jiàn zhēn guì de cí qì yǐ jīng suì le。 zhè shí wǒ cái hòu huǐ rēng diào le nà xiē kàn qǐ lái hǎo xiàng méi yòng de fèi zhǐ。

qí shí méi yǒu shén me dōng xi shì wán quán méi yòng de， nǎ pà shì nà xiē fèi zhǐ， zài mǒu xiē fāng miàn， tā men yě yǒu zhe zì jǐ dú tè de gōng néng。 zhǐ yào yòng dào hé shì de dì fang， fèi zhǐ yě néng fā huī zhòng yào de zuò yòng。 suǒ yǐ， bù yào kàn qīng bié rén， kàn qīng nà xiē " fèi zhǐ”， yīn wèi rèn hé shì wù dōu yǒu zì jǐ de jià zhí。
english_paragraphs: When I was traveling, I bought a precious piece of porcelain. The porcelain was packed in a big box, and the gaps in the big box were filled with waste paper. Considering that the big box was inconvenient to carry, I threw away the big box and the waste paper inside, and put the porcelain directly into my suitcase.

When I got in the car, my suitcase fell heavily to the ground due to accident. When I opened the suitcase, I saw that the precious porcelain was broken. Only then did I regret throwing away those seemingly useless pieces of paper.

In fact, nothing is completely useless. Even those waste papers have their own unique functions in some aspects. As long as it is used in the right place, waste paper can also play an important role. So, don't look down on others or those "waste papers", because everything has its own value.

4354.title: Please Apologize for Your Compliment
simplified_paragraphs: 有一次，朋友去一个教授家中做客。教授有个五岁的小女儿，长得非常漂亮。朋友对小女孩说："你长得真漂亮。”并把带去的礼物给了她。小女孩有礼貌地微笑着说："谢谢。”教授等女儿离开后，很严肃地对朋友说："请你为你刚才的夸奖道歉。”
朋友感到很吃惊，但是教授继续说："你夸孩子漂亮，孩子很可能会把天生的美丽看成是她值得骄傲的资本，这是一种错误的引导。不过你还有机会弥补，你可以夸奖她的微笑和有礼貌，这是她自己努力的结果。”后来朋友就很正式地向教授的小女儿道了歉，同时表扬了她的礼貌。
对孩子容貌的夸奖需要谨慎，因为从他们成长的角度来说，对他们良好行为的夸奖更加重要。

pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yī cì， péng you qù yī gè jiào shòu jiā zhōng zuò kè。 jiào shòu yǒu gè wǔ suì de xiǎo nǚ ér， zhǎng de fēi cháng piào liang。 péng you duì xiǎo nǚ hái shuō：" nǐ zhǎng de zhēn piào liang。” bìng bǎ dài qù de lǐ wù gěi le tā。 xiǎo nǚ hái yǒu lǐ mào de wēi xiào zhe shuō：" xiè xie。” jiào shòu děng nǚ ér lí kāi hòu， hěn yán sù de duì péng you shuō：" qǐng nǐ wèi nǐ gāng cái de kuā jiǎng dào qiàn。”

péng you gǎn dào hěn chī jīng， dàn shì jiào shòu jì xù shuō：" nǐ kuā hái zi piào liang， hái zi hěn kě néng huì bǎ tiān shēng de měi lì kàn chéng shì tā zhí dé jiāo ào de zī běn， zhè shì yī zhǒng cuò wù de yǐn dǎo。 bù guò nǐ hái yǒu jī huì mí bǔ， nǐ kě yǐ kuā jiǎng tā de wēi xiào hé yǒu lǐ mào， zhè shì tā zì jǐ nǔ lì de jié guǒ。” hòu lái péng you jiù hěn zhèng shì de xiàng jiào shòu de xiǎo nǚ ér dào le qiàn， tóng shí biǎo yáng le tā de lǐ mào。
duì hái zi róng mào de kuā jiǎng xū yào jǐn shèn， yīn wèi cóng tā men chéng zhǎng de jiǎo dù lái shuō， duì tā men liáng hǎo xíng wéi de kuā jiǎng gèng jiā zhòng yào。
english_paragraphs: Once, a friend went to a professor's home as a guest. The professor has a five-year-old daughter who is very beautiful. The friend said to the little girl: "You are so beautiful." and gave her the gift he had brought. The little girl smiled politely and said, "Thank you." After the professor waited for his daughter to leave, he said to his friend seriously: "Please apologize for the compliment you just gave."

The friend was surprised, but the professor continued: "If you praise the child for her beauty, the child will probably regard her natural beauty as something she can be proud of. This is a wrong guide. But you still have a chance to make up for it. You can praise her smile and politeness, which are the result of her own efforts." Later, the friend formally apologized to the professor's youngest daughter and praised her politeness.
Praise for children's appearance needs to be cautious, because from the perspective of their growth, praise for their good behavior is more important.

4312.title: A Beautiful Word
simplified_paragraphs: 牛津大学有一个叫凯丽的女孩。上大学前，她一直都是好学生，但到牛津大学后，她却成为了全班最差的学生。其实，并不是凯丽不聪明，也不是她不努力，而是她太自卑了。
一天，凯丽正在上课，有个人走进教室说，他要在班里找一个最漂亮的女孩做他们公司的形象代言人。这个人看了看教室里的学生，最后指着凯丽说："就是她，她是我眼中最美丽的女孩。”
其实，这个人是凯丽的父亲找来的，为的是帮助凯丽找回自信。从此，凯丽又有了自信，并成为了一个优秀的学生。

其實，這個人是凱麗的父親找來的，為的是幫助凱麗找回自信。從此，凱麗又有了自信，並成為了一個優秀的學生。

yī tiān， Kǎi Lì zhèng zài shàng kè， yǒu gè rén zǒu jìn jiào shì shuō， tā yào zài bān lǐ zhǎo yī gè zuì piào liang de nǚ hái zuò tā men gōng sī de xíng xiàng dài yán rén。 zhè gè rén kàn le kàn jiào shì lǐ de xué shēng， zuì hòu zhǐ zhe Kǎi Lì shuō：" jiù shì tā， tā shì wǒ yǎn zhōng zuì měi lì de nǚ hái。”
qí shí， zhè gè rén shì Kǎi Lì de fù qīn zhǎo lái de， wèi de shì bāng zhù Kǎi Lì zhǎo huí zì xìn。 cóng cǐ， Kǎi Lì yòu yǒu le zì xìn， bìng chéng wéi le yī gè yōu xiù de xué shēng。
english_paragraphs: There is a girl named Kelly at Oxford University. Before going to college, she had always been a good student, but after arriving at Oxford, she became the worst student in the class. In fact, it's not that Kelly isn't smart or doesn't work hard, it's that she has too low self-esteem.

One day, Kelly was in class, and someone walked into the classroom and said that he wanted to find the most beautiful girl in the class to be the image spokesperson of their company. The man looked at the students in the classroom, and finally pointed at Kelly and said, "That's her. She is the most beautiful girl in my eyes."
In fact, this person was found by Kelly's father to help Kelly regain her confidence. From then on, Kelly gained confidence again and became an excellent student.

4210.title: Please Take the First Step
simplified_paragraphs: 有一个人要到另外一个美丽的城市去，那个城市很近，走路只要1个小时。正因为近，这个人就不着急，始终不愿意迈出第一步。他每天要喝茶，要看电视，要听音乐……总之，要做的事情太多了，他太忙了。
他没有忘记自己还要赶路，可是真到下决心要走时，就又安慰自己："反正1个小时就到了，不用着急。”
就这样，虽然那个美丽的城市很近，但是这个人一生都没能到达目的地。不迈出第一步，再近也到不了呀！
traditional_paragraphs: 有一個人要到另外一個美麗的城市去，那個城市很近，走路只要1個小時。正因為近，這個人就不著急，始終不願意邁出第一步。他每天要喝茶，要看電視，要聽音樂……總之，要做的事情太多了，他太忙了。
他沒有忘記自己還要趕路，可是真到下決心要走時，就又安慰自己："反正1個小時就到了，不用著急。”

simplified_paragraphs: 父亲与儿子做游戏：10分钟代表一个人的一生，在这10分钟里，每人从一本书里找"黄金”这个词语，谁找得多谁就赢……游戏开始后，儿子和父亲都找得很努力。9分钟的时候，儿子一共找到了10个，而父亲却只找到了4个。"
爸爸，你输了。”儿子兴奋地说。父亲说："我承认我输了。可是就这么结束了吗？”父亲看了看时间，说：”9分40秒了，10分钟的一生很快就要结束了。虽然你有很多黄金，但是你已经没有时间去享用了，其实时间比黄金更宝贵！”

4137.title: Grinding Axe
simplified_paragraphs: 有个工人在一家木材厂找到了一份工作，报酬不错，工作条件也好，所以他很珍惜，下决心要好好干。
第一天，老板给了他一把锋利的斧子。这一天，这个工人砍了18棵树。老板说："不错，就这么干!”工人很受鼓舞，第二天，他干得更加起劲，但是他只砍了15棵树。第三天，他加倍努力，可是只砍了10棵。工人觉得很惭愧，跑到老板那儿道歉，说自己的力气好像越来越小了。
老板问他："你上一次磨斧子是什么时候?”"磨斧子?”工人诧异地说，"我每天忙着砍树，哪里有时间磨斧子!”老板笑着说："不是你的力气变小了，而是因为你的斧子已经不像第一天那样锋利了。”

dì yī tiān， lǎo bǎn gěi le tā yī bǎ fēng lì de fǔ zi。 zhè yī tiān， zhè gè gōng rén kǎn le 18 kē shù。 lǎo bǎn shuō：" bù cuò， jiù zhè me gàn !” gōng rén hěn shòu gǔ wǔ， dì èr tiān， tā gàn de gèng jiā qǐ jìn， dàn shì tā zhǐ kǎn le 15 kē shù。 dì sān tiān， tā jiā bèi nǔ lì， kě shì zhǐ kǎn le 10 kē。 gōng rén jué de hěn cán kuì， pǎo dào lǎo bǎn nà r dào qiàn， shuō zì jǐ de lì qi hǎo xiàng yuè lái yuè xiǎo le。

lǎo bǎn wèn tā：" nǐ shàng yī cì mó fǔ zi shì shén me shí hou ?”" mó fǔ zi ?” gōng rén chà yì de shuō，" wǒ měi tiān máng zhe kǎn shù， nǎ lǐ yǒu shí jiān mó fǔ zi !” lǎo bǎn xiào zhe shuō：" bù shì nǐ de lì qi biàn xiǎo le， ér shì yīn wèi nǐ de fǔ zi yǐ jīng bù xiàng dì yī tiān nà yàng fēng lì le。”
english_paragraphs: A worker found a job in a lumber factory. The pay was good and the working conditions were good, so he cherished it and was determined to do a good job.

On the first day, the boss gave him a sharp axe. On this day, the worker cut down 18 trees. The boss said: "Yes, let's do it!" The worker was very encouraged. The next day, he worked even harder, but he only cut down 15 trees. On the third day, he worked harder, but only cut down 10 trees. The worker felt very ashamed and went to the boss to apologize, saying that his strength seemed to be getting weaker and weaker.

The boss asked him: "When was the last time you sharpened an axe?" "Grinding an axe?" The worker said in surprise, "I am busy cutting trees every day, so how can I have time to sharpen an axe!" The boss smiled and said, "It's not that your strength has become smaller, but because your ax is not as sharp as the first day."

4237.title: Attitude Determines the Future
simplified_paragraphs: 有三个工人正在砌墙。有人问他们："你们在干什么？”
第一个人不耐烦地说："没看见吗？我在砌墙！”第二个人抬头苦笑着说："我们在盖一栋高楼。不过这份工作真是不轻松啊。”第三个人高兴地说："我们正在建设一座城市。我们现在所盖的这栋大楼未来将成为城市的标致性建筑之一啊！能参与这样一个工程，真是让人兴奋。”
十年后，第一个人依然在砌墙；第二个人坐在办公室里画图纸——他成了工程师；第三个人，成了一家房地产公司的总裁,是前两个人的老板。
态度决定未来,第三个工人对工作的热情以及认真态度，是他获得成功的关键。
traditional_paragraphs: 有三個工人正在砌牆。有人問他們："你們在幹什麼？”
第一個人不耐煩地說："沒看見嗎？我在砌牆！”第二個人抬頭苦笑著說："我們在蓋一棟高樓。不過這份工作真是不輕鬆啊。”第三個人高興地說："我們正在建設一座城市。我們現在所蓋的這棟大樓未來將成為城市的標致性建築之一啊！能參與這樣一個工程，真是讓人興奮。”
十年後，第一個人依然在砌牆；第二個人坐在辦公室裡畫圖紙——他成了工程師；第三個人，成了一家房地產公司的總裁,是前兩個人的老闆。
態度決定未來,第三個工人對工作的熱情以及認真態度，是他獲得成功的關鍵。
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu sān gè gōng rén zhèng zài qì qiáng。 yǒu rén wèn tā men：" nǐ men zài gàn shén me？”

dì yī gè rén bù nài fán de shuō：" méi kàn jiàn ma？ wǒ zài qì qiáng！” dì èr gè rén tái tóu kǔ xiào zhe shuō：" wǒ men zài gài yī dòng gāo lóu。 bù guò zhè fèn gōng zuò zhēn shì bù qīng sōng a。” dì sān gè rén gāo xìng de shuō：" wǒ men zhèng zài jiàn shè yī zuò chéng shì。 wǒ men xiàn zài suǒ gài de zhè dòng dà lóu wèi lái jiāng chéng wéi chéng shì de biāo zhì xìng jiàn zhù zhī yī a！ néng cān yù zhè yàng yī gè gōng chéng， zhēn shì ràng rén xīng fèn。”

shí nián hòu， dì yī gè rén yī rán zài qì qiáng； dì èr gè rén zuò zài bàn gōng shì lǐ huà tú zhǐ —— tā chéng le gōng chéng shī； dì sān gè rén， chéng le yī jiā fáng dì chǎn gōng sī de zǒng cái , shì qián liǎng gè rén de lǎo bǎn。
tài dù jué dìng wèi lái , dì sān gè gōng rén duì gōng zuò de rè qíng yǐ jí rèn zhēn tài dù， shì tā huò dé chéng gōng de guān jiàn。
english_paragraphs: There are three workers building a wall. Someone asked them: "What are you doing?"

The first person said impatiently: "Don't you see? I'm building a wall!" The second person looked up and said with a wry smile: "We are building a high-rise building. But this job is really not easy." The third person said happily: "We are building a city. The building we are building now will become one of the city's landmark buildings in the future! It is really exciting to be involved in such a project."

Ten years later, the first person was still building walls; the second person was sitting in the office drawing drawings - he became an engineer; the third person became the president of a real estate company and was the boss of the first two people.
Attitude determines the future. The third worker's enthusiasm and serious attitude towards work are the key to his success.
